  Color _titleColor(BuildContext context) =>
      _isDark(context) ? AppTheme.textPrimary : AppTheme.lightTextPrimary;
  Color _bodyColor(BuildContext context) =>
      _isDark(context) ? AppTheme.textSecondary : AppTheme.lightTextSecondary;
  Color _primaryText(BuildContext context) =>
      _isDark(context) ? AppTheme.textPrimary : AppTheme.lightTextPrimary;

  final Set<int> _profitLossBoldRows = {};
  final Set<int> _neracaBoldRows = {};

  // Diagonal scrolling state

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scrollController.addListener(_syncScroll);
    _table1Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table1Controller));
    _table2Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table2Controller));
    _table3Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table3Controller));
    _table3aController.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table3aController));
    _table4Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table4Controller));
    _table5Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table5Controller));
    _table6Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table6Controller));
    _table7Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table7Controller));
    _table8Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table8Controller));
    _table9Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table9Controller));
    _table10Controller.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table10Controller));
    _table3bController.addListener(() => _syncHorizontal(_table3bController));
    _zoomController = TextEditingController(text: '100');
    _loadDefaultReportYearAndFetch();
    _fetchCategories();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scrollController.dispose();
    _table1Controller.dispose();
    _table2Controller.dispose();
    _table3Controller.dispose();
    _table3aController.dispose();
    _table4Controller.dispose();
    _table5Controller.dispose();
    _table6Controller.dispose();
    _table7Controller.dispose();
    _table8Controller.dispose();
    _table9Controller.dispose();
    _table10Controller.dispose();
    _table3bController.dispose();
    _table1VController.dispose();
    _table2VController.dispose();
    _table3VController.dispose();
    _table3aVController.dispose();
    _table4VController.dispose();
    _table5VController.dispose();
    _table6VController.dispose();
    _table7VController.dispose();
    _table8VController.dispose();
    _table9VController.dispose();
    _table10VController.dispose();
    _table3bVController.dispose();
    _zoomController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _syncScroll() {}
  void _syncHorizontal(ScrollController controller) {
    if (!controller.hasClients || _isSyncing) return;
    final offset = controller.offset;
    _isSyncing = true;

    // Performance Optimization: Only sync tables that are currently visible
    final Map<ScrollController, String> controllerToId = {
      _table1Controller: 't1',
      _table2Controller: 't2',
      _table3Controller: 't3',
      _table3aController: 't3a',
      _table4Controller: 't4',
      _table5Controller: 't5',
      _table6Controller: 't6',
      _table7Controller: 't7',
      _table8Controller: 't8',
      _table9Controller: 't9',
      _table10Controller: 't10',
      _table3bController: 't3b',
    };

    for (final entry in controllerToId.entries) {
      final other = entry.key;
      final id = entry.value;

      if (_visibleTables.contains(id) &&
          other.hasClients &&
          other != controller) {
        final max = other.position.maxScrollExtent;
        if (max <= 0) continue;
        final targetOffset = offset.clamp(0.0, max);
        if ((other.offset - targetOffset).abs() > 0.5) {
          other.jumpTo(targetOffset);
        }
      }
    }
    _isSyncing = false;
  }

  Future<void> _fetchCategories() async {
    try {
      final api = context.read<AuthProvider>().api;
      final res = await api.getCategories();
      if (res.containsKey('categories')) {
        final cats = (res['categories'] as List)
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e))
            .toList();
        cats.sort(
          (a, b) => (a['sort_order'] ?? 999).compareTo(b['sort_order'] ?? 999),
        );
        if (mounted) setState(() => _categories = cats);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _loadDefaultReportYearAndFetch() async {
    try {
      final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
      await prov.syncReportYear();
      if (mounted) setState(() => _selectedYear = prov.reportYear);
    } catch (_) {}
    await _fetchReport();
  }

  Future<void> _fetchReport() async {
    await _fetchCategories();
    final controllers = <ScrollController>[
      _scrollController,
      _table1Controller,
      _table2Controller,
      _table3Controller,
      _table4Controller,
      _table5Controller,
      _table6Controller,
      _table7Controller,
      _table8Controller,
      _table9Controller,
      _table10Controller,
      _table1VController,
      _table2VController,
      _table3VController,
      _table4VController,
      _table5VController,
      _table6VController,
      _table7VController,
      _table8VController,
      _table9VController,
      _table10VController,
    ];
    for (final c in controllers) {
      if (c.hasClients) c.jumpTo(0);
    }
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _cachedGroupedExpenses = null;
      _subcategoryLabelCache.clear();
    });
    try {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final api = context.read<AuthProvider>().api;

      // Persiapkan parameter tanggal untuk mode range
      final effectiveStartDate = _filterMode == 'range' && _startDate != null
          ? DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(_startDate!)
          : null;
      final effectiveEndDate = _filterMode == 'range' && _endDate != null
          ? DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(_endDate!)
          : null;

      // Note: Backend getAnnualReport might need updates if it doesn't support startDate/endDate yet
      // For now we keep existing signature but add support if needed
      final data = await api.getAnnualReport(
        year: _filterMode == 'range' ? null : _selectedYear,
        mode: _filterMode,
        startDate: effectiveStartDate,
        endDate: effectiveEndDate,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _reportData = data;
          // Pre-calculate grouping immediately after data arrives
          final rawExpenses = _asListMap(data['operation_cost']?['data']);
          if (rawExpenses.isNotEmpty) {
            _cachedGroupedExpenses = _groupAnnualExpenses(rawExpenses);
          }
          // Pre-process all tables into displayable format
          _processAllTables();
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Failed: $e'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _processAllTables() {
    if (_reportData == null) return;

    _tableDataCache.clear();

    // 1. REVENUE (Tabel 1)
    final revenueData = _asListMap(_reportData?['revenue']?['data']);
    final List<List<String>> revenueRows = revenueData
        .asMap()
        .entries
        .map(
          (e) => [
            _fmtDate(e.value['invoice_date']),
            '${e.key + 1}',
            (e.value['description']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                ? '-'
                : e.value['description'].toString(),
            _fmtMoney(e.value['invoice_value']),
            e.value['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
            _toDouble(e.value['currency_exchange'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
            (e.value['invoice_number']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                ? '-'
                : e.value['invoice_number'].toString(),
            (e.value['client']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                ? '-'
                : e.value['client'].toString(),
            _fmtDate(e.value['receive_date']),
            _fmtMoney(e.value['amount_received']),
            _fmtMoney(e.value['ppn']),
            _fmtMoney(e.value['pph_23']),
            _fmtMoney(e.value['transfer_fee']),
            (e.value['remark']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                ? '-'
                : e.value['remark'].toString(),
          ],
        )
        .toList();
    revenueRows.add([
      'TOTAL',
      '-',
      '-',
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['revenue']?['total_amount_received'] ?? 0),
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['revenue']?['total_amount_received'] ?? 0),
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['revenue']?['total_ppn'] ?? 0),
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['revenue']?['total_pph23'] ?? 0),
      '-',
      '-',
    ]);
    _tableDataCache['t1'] = ReportTableData(rows: revenueRows);

    // 2. TAX (Tabel 2)
    final taxData = _asListMap(_reportData?['tax']?['data']);
    final List<List<String>> taxRows = taxData.asMap().entries.map((e) {
      final transVal = _toDouble(e.value['transaction_value'] ?? 0);
      final ppn = _toDouble(e.value['ppn'] ?? 0);
      final pph21 = _toDouble(e.value['pph_21'] ?? 0);
      final pph23 = _toDouble(e.value['pph_23'] ?? 0);
      final pph26 = _toDouble(e.value['pph_26'] ?? 0);

      return [
        _fmtDate(e.value['date']),
        '${e.key + 1}',
        e.value['description']?.toString() ?? '',
        _fmtMoney(transVal),
        e.value['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
        _toDouble(e.value['currency_exchange'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
        ppn > 0 ? _fmtMoney(transVal) : '-',
        ppn > 0 ? _fmtMoney(ppn) : '-',
        pph21 > 0 ? _fmtMoney(transVal) : '-',
        pph21 > 0 ? _fmtMoney(pph21) : '-',
        pph23 > 0 ? _fmtMoney(transVal) : '-',
        pph23 > 0 ? _fmtMoney(pph23) : '-',
        pph26 > 0 ? _fmtMoney(transVal) : '-',
        pph26 > 0 ? _fmtMoney(pph26) : '-',
      ];
    }).toList();
    taxRows.add([
      'TOTAL',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['tax']?['total_ppn'] ?? 0),
      '-',
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['tax']?['total_pph21'] ?? 0),
      '-',
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['tax']?['total_pph23'] ?? 0),
      '-',
      _fmtMoney(_reportData?['tax']?['total_pph26'] ?? 0),
    ]);
    _tableDataCache['t2'] = ReportTableData(rows: taxRows);

    // 3. BANK STATUS (Tabel 3)
    _tableDataCache['t3'] = ReportTableData(rows: _buildTable3Rows());

    // 3A. BIAYA ADMIN (Tabel 3A)
    _tableDataCache['t3a'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: _buildTable3aRows(),
      boldRows: {
        (_asListMap(
          _reportData!['admin_fees']?['data'],
        )).where((d) => d['is_admin_fee_extra'] != true).length,
      },
    );

    // 4. EXPENSES (Tabel 4 & 5)
    _processTable4And5();

    // 6. ASSET REGISTER (Tabel 6)
    _tableDataCache['t6'] = ReportTableData(rows: _buildTable6Rows());

    // 7 & 8. PROFIT LOSS & NERACA
    _tableDataCache['t7'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: _buildTable7Rows(),
      boldRows: Set.from(_profitLossBoldRows),
    );
    _tableDataCache['t8'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: _buildTable8Rows(),
      boldRows: Set.from(_neracaBoldRows),
    );

    // 9. DEVIDEN (Tabel 10)
    _tableDataCache['t10'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: _buildTable10Rows(),
      headers: const ['#', 'Nama Lengkap', 'Rp', 'Amount'],
    );

    // 10. BUSINESS SUMMARY
    _tableDataCache['t9'] = ReportTableData(rows: _buildTable9Rows());

    // 3B. BIAYA ADMIN BANK (DIRECT)
    _tableDataCache['t3b'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: _buildTable11Rows(),
      boldRows: {
        (_asListMap(
          _reportData!['admin_fees']?['data'],
        )).where((d) => d['is_admin_fee_extra'] == true).length,
      }, // Bold total row
    );

    // 3C. RETURNED FUNDS (Tabel 3C)
    final returnedFundsData = _asListMap(
      _reportData?['returned_funds']?['data'],
    );
    final List<List<String>> returnedFundsRows = returnedFundsData
        .asMap()
        .entries
        .map<List<String>>(
          (entry) => [
            entry.value['date'] ?? '-',
            '${entry.key + 1}',
            entry.value['title'] ?? '-',
            entry.value['type'] ?? '-',
            'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(entry.value['approved_amount'] ?? 0)}',
            'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(entry.value['disbursed_amount'] ?? 0)}',
            'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(entry.value['returned_amount'] ?? 0)}',
            entry.value['return_source'] ??
                entry.value['disbursement_source'] ??
                entry.value['bank_name'] ??
                '-',
            entry.value['id'].toString(),
          ],
        )
        .toList();
    if (returnedFundsRows.isNotEmpty) {
      final totalRet = _reportData?['returned_funds']?['total_returned'] ?? 0;
      returnedFundsRows.add([
        'TOTAL',
        '-',
        '-',
        '-',
        '-',
        '-',
        'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(totalRet)}',
        '-',
        '-',
      ]);
    }
    _tableDataCache['t3c'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: returnedFundsRows,
      boldRows: {
        if (returnedFundsRows.isNotEmpty) returnedFundsRows.length - 1,
      },
    );
  }

  void _processTable4And5() {
    final expenseGroups = _cachedGroupedExpenses;
    if (expenseGroups == null || expenseGroups.isEmpty) {
      _tableDataCache['t4'] = ReportTableData(rows: [], headers: ['Expenses']);
      _tableDataCache['t5'] = ReportTableData(rows: [], headers: ['Expenses']);
      return;
    }

    final Map<int, double> tempTotals = {};
    for (final group in expenseGroups) {
      for (final e in group) {
        final catName = (e['category_name'] ?? '').toString();
        final amount = _toDouble(e['idr_amount'] ?? e['amount']);
        int catId = -1;
        for (final c in _categories) {
          if ((c['name'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() ==
              catName.toLowerCase()) {
            catId = c['id'];
            break;
          }
        }
        if (catId != -1) {
          tempTotals[catId] = (tempTotals[catId] ?? 0) + amount;
        }
      }
    }

    final filteredCategories = _categories.where((c) {
      final id = c['id'];
      return (tempTotals[id] ?? 0) > 0;
    }).toList();

    final catHeaders = filteredCategories.isNotEmpty
        ? filteredCategories.map((c) => (c['name'] ?? '').toString()).toList()
        : ['Expenses'];
    final catTotals = List<double>.filled(catHeaders.length, 0);
    double grandTotalExpense = 0;

    int getFilteredCatIndex(String categoryName) {
      final target = categoryName.toLowerCase().trim();
      for (int i = 0; i < filteredCategories.length; i++) {
        final name =
            (filteredCategories[i]['name'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
        if (name == target) return i;
      }
      return -1;
    }

    final List<List<String>> expenseRows = <List<String>>[];
    final expenseBoldRows = <int>{};

    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allSingles = [];
    final List<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> allBatches = [];
    for (final group in expenseGroups) {
      if (_isBatchSettlement(group.first)) {
        allBatches.add(group);
      } else {
        allSingles.addAll(group);
      }
    }

    allBatches.sort(
      (a, b) => (int.tryParse(a.first['settlement_id']?.toString() ?? '0') ?? 0)
          .compareTo(
        int.tryParse(b.first['settlement_id']?.toString() ?? '0') ?? 0,
      ),
    );

    // 1. Single Expenses
    final Map<String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>> singleMap = {};
    for (final e in allSingles) {
      final sub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(e);
      singleMap.putIfAbsent(sub, () => []).add(e);
    }
    final sortedSingleSubs = singleMap.keys.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final aExpense = singleMap[a]!.first;
        final bExpense = singleMap[b]!.first;
        final aCatIdx = getFilteredCatIndex(aExpense['category_name'] ?? '');
        final bCatIdx = getFilteredCatIndex(bExpense['category_name'] ?? '');
        if (aCatIdx != bCatIdx) return aCatIdx.compareTo(bCatIdx);
        return a.toLowerCase().compareTo(b.toLowerCase());
      });

    int singleCounter = 0;
    for (final sub in sortedSingleSubs) {
      expenseBoldRows.add(expenseRows.length);
      expenseRows.add([
        '',
        '',
        sub,
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
        '',
        '',
      ]);
      for (final e in singleMap[sub]!) {
        singleCounter++;
        final idrAmount = _toDouble(e['idr_amount'] ?? e['amount']);
        final idx = getFilteredCatIndex(e['category_name'] ?? '');
        final rowCats = List<String>.filled(catHeaders.length, '-');
        if (idx != -1 && idx < catHeaders.length) {
          rowCats[idx] = _fmtMoney(idrAmount);
          catTotals[idx] += idrAmount;
        }
        grandTotalExpense += idrAmount;
        expenseRows.add([
          _fmtDate(e['date']),
          '$singleCounter',
          e['description']?.toString() ?? '',
          (e['source']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
              ? '-'
              : e['source'].toString(),
          _currencyFormat.format(_toDouble(e['amount'])),
          e['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
          _toDouble(e['currency_exchange'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
          ...rowCats,
          _fmtMoney(idrAmount),
          '-',
        ]);
      }
    }

    // 2. Header Pengeluaran dan Kantor (As Separator)
    expenseBoldRows.add(expenseRows.length);
    expenseRows.add([
      '',
      '',
      'Pengeluaran dan Kantor - Expenses Report',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
      '',
      '',
    ]);

    // 3. Batch Expenses (Expense#1, #2...)
    int batchCounter = 0;
    for (final batch in allBatches) {
      batchCounter++;
      expenseBoldRows.add(expenseRows.length);
      final settlementTitle =
          (batch.first['settlement_title'] ?? 'Tanpa Settlement').toString();
      expenseRows.add([
        'Expense#$batchCounter',
        ':',
        settlementTitle,
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
        '',
        '',
      ]);

      double batchTotal = 0;
      int totalItemsInBatch = batch.length;
      int currentItemIndex = 0;

      final Map<String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>> subMap = {};
      for (final e in batch) {
        final sub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(e);
        subMap.putIfAbsent(sub, () => []).add(e);
      }
      final sortedSubs = subMap.keys.toList()
        ..sort((a, b) {
          final aExpense = subMap[a]!.first;
          final bExpense = subMap[b]!.first;
          final aCatIdx = getFilteredCatIndex(aExpense['category_name'] ?? '');
          final bCatIdx = getFilteredCatIndex(bExpense['category_name'] ?? '');
          if (aCatIdx != bCatIdx) return aCatIdx.compareTo(bCatIdx);
          return a.toLowerCase().compareTo(b.toLowerCase());
        });
      for (final sub in sortedSubs) {
        expenseBoldRows.add(expenseRows.length);
        expenseRows.add([
          '',
          '',
          sub,
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
          '',
          '',
        ]);
        final items = subMap[sub]!;
        for (int i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
          final e = items[i];
          singleCounter++;
          final idrAmount = _toDouble(e['idr_amount'] ?? e['amount']);
          final idx = getFilteredCatIndex(e['category_name'] ?? '');
          final rowCats = List<String>.filled(catHeaders.length, '-');
          if (idx != -1 && idx < catHeaders.length) {
            rowCats[idx] = _fmtMoney(idrAmount);
            catTotals[idx] += idrAmount;
          }
          batchTotal += idrAmount;
          grandTotalExpense += idrAmount;
          currentItemIndex++;

          expenseRows.add([
            _fmtDate(e['date']),
            '$singleCounter',
            e['description']?.toString() ?? '',
            (e['source']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                ? '-'
                : e['source'].toString(),
            _currencyFormat.format(_toDouble(e['amount'])),
            e['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
            _toDouble(e['currency_exchange'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
            ...rowCats,
            _fmtMoney(idrAmount),
            (currentItemIndex == totalItemsInBatch)
                ? _fmtMoney(batchTotal)
                : '-',
          ]);
        }
      }
    }

    expenseRows.add([
      'TOTAL',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      ...catTotals.map(_fmtMoney),
      _fmtMoney(grandTotalExpense),
      _fmtMoney(grandTotalExpense),
    ]);
    _tableDataCache['t4'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: expenseRows,
      boldRows: expenseBoldRows,
      headers: catHeaders,
    );

    _processBankExpenseTable(
      allSingles,
      allBatches,
      catHeaders,
      getFilteredCatIndex,
    );
  }

  void _processBankExpenseTable(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> allSingles,
    List<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> allBatches,
    List<String> catHeaders,
    int Function(String) getFilteredCatIndex,
  ) {
    final List<List<String>> bankRows = <List<String>>[];
    final bankBoldRows = <int>{};
    int rowCounter = 0;

    final Map<String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>> bankSingleMap = {};
    for (final e in allSingles) {
      String bank = (e['bank_name']?.toString() ?? '').trim();
      if (bank.isEmpty || bank == 'None' || bank == '-') {
        // Fallback to source (BCA, BRI, etc.) if bank_name is empty
        bank = (e['source']?.toString() ?? '').trim();
      }
      if (bank.isEmpty || bank == 'None') bank = '-';
      bankSingleMap.putIfAbsent(bank, () => []).add(e);
    }
    final sortedBanks = bankSingleMap.keys.toList()..sort();
    double grandTotalBank = 0;

    for (final bank in sortedBanks) {
      final bankItems = bankSingleMap[bank]!;
      final bankLabel = bank == '-' ? '-' : bank;

      final transfers = bankItems.where((e) {
        final sub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(e).toLowerCase();
        final parent = (e['category_name']?.toString() ?? '').toLowerCase();

        // Is it an Admin Fee? (Sub contains 'biaya bank'/'biaya admin' OR Parent is 'administrasi' with 'admin' keyword)
        final isAdmin = sub.contains('biaya bank') ||
            sub.contains('biaya admin') ||
            (parent == 'administrasi' && sub.contains('admin'));

        return !isAdmin;
      }).toList();

      final adminFees = bankItems.where((e) {
        final sub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(e).toLowerCase();
        final parent = (e['category_name']?.toString() ?? '').toLowerCase();

        final isAdmin = sub.contains('biaya bank') ||
            sub.contains('biaya admin') ||
            (parent == 'administrasi' && sub.contains('admin'));

        return isAdmin;
      }).toList();

      if (transfers.isNotEmpty) {
        bankBoldRows.add(bankRows.length);
        bankRows.add([
          '',
          '',
          'Transfer from $bankLabel account',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
          '',
          '',
        ]);
        double groupTotal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < transfers.length; i++) {
          final e = transfers[i];
          rowCounter++;
          final amt = _toDouble(e['idr_amount'] ?? e['amount']);
          final idx = getFilteredCatIndex(e['category_name'] ?? '');
          final rowCats = List<String>.filled(catHeaders.length, '-');
          if (idx != -1) rowCats[idx] = _fmtMoney(amt);
          groupTotal += amt;
          grandTotalBank += amt;
          bankRows.add([
            _fmtDate(e['date']),
            '$rowCounter',
            e['description']?.toString() ?? '',
            (e['source']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                ? '-'
                : e['source'].toString(),
            _currencyFormat.format(_toDouble(e['amount'])),
            e['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
            _toDouble(e['currency_exchange'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
            ...rowCats,
            _fmtMoney(amt),
            (i == transfers.length - 1) ? _fmtMoney(groupTotal) : '-',
          ]);
        }
      }
      if (adminFees.isNotEmpty) {
        bankBoldRows.add(bankRows.length);
        bankRows.add([
          '',
          '',
          'Biaya Admin $bankLabel',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
          '',
          '',
        ]);
        double groupTotal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < adminFees.length; i++) {
          final e = adminFees[i];
          rowCounter++;
          final amt = _toDouble(e['idr_amount'] ?? e['amount']);
          final idx = getFilteredCatIndex(e['category_name'] ?? '');
          final rowCats = List<String>.filled(catHeaders.length, '-');
          if (idx != -1) rowCats[idx] = _fmtMoney(amt);
          groupTotal += amt;
          grandTotalBank += amt;
          bankRows.add([
            _fmtDate(e['date']),
            '$rowCounter',
            e['description']?.toString() ?? '',
            (e['source']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                ? '-'
                : e['source'].toString(),
            _currencyFormat.format(_toDouble(e['amount'])),
            e['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
            _toDouble(e['currency_exchange'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
            ...rowCats,
            _fmtMoney(amt),
            (i == adminFees.length - 1) ? _fmtMoney(groupTotal) : '-',
          ]);
        }
      }
    }

    // 2. Header Pengeluaran dan Kantor (As Separator for Tabel 5)
    bankBoldRows.add(bankRows.length);
    bankRows.add([
      '',
      '',
      'Pengeluaran dan Kantor - Expenses Report',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
      '',
      '',
    ]);

    if (allBatches.isNotEmpty) {
      int batchCounter = 0;
      for (final batch in allBatches) {
        batchCounter++;
        bankBoldRows.add(bankRows.length);
        final settlementTitle =
            (batch.first['settlement_title'] ?? 'Tanpa Settlement').toString();
        bankRows.add([
          'Expense#$batchCounter',
          ':',
          settlementTitle,
          '',
          '',
          '',
          '',
          ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
          '',
          '',
        ]);

        double batchTotal = 0;
        int totalItemsInBatch = batch.length;
        int currentItemIndex = 0;

        // Group by Bank -> Subcategory for THIS batch
        final Map<String, Map<String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>>
            batchByBankSub = {};
        for (var e in batch) {
          String bank = (e['bank_name']?.toString() ?? '').trim();
          if (bank.isEmpty || bank == 'None' || bank == '-') {
            // Fallback to source (BCA, BRI, etc.) if bank_name is empty
            bank = (e['source']?.toString() ?? '').trim();
          }
          if (bank.isEmpty || bank == 'None') bank = '-';
          final sub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(e);
          batchByBankSub
              .putIfAbsent(bank, () => {})
              .putIfAbsent(sub, () => [])
              .add(e);
        }

        for (var bank in batchByBankSub.keys.toList()..sort()) {
          bankBoldRows.add(bankRows.length);
          bankRows.add([
            '',
            '',
            'Bank : $bank',
            '',
            '',
            '',
            '',
            ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, ''),
            '',
            '',
          ]);

          final items = batchByBankSub[bank]!;
          // Flatten items directly without subcategory headers
          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allBankItems = [];
          for (var sub in items.keys.toList()..sort()) {
            allBankItems.addAll(items[sub]!);
          }

          for (int i = 0; i < allBankItems.length; i++) {
            final e = allBankItems[i];
            rowCounter++;
            final amt = _toDouble(e['idr_amount'] ?? e['amount']);
            final idx = getFilteredCatIndex(e['category_name'] ?? '');
            final rowCats = List<String>.filled(catHeaders.length, '-');
            if (idx != -1) rowCats[idx] = _fmtMoney(amt);
            batchTotal += amt;
            grandTotalBank += amt;
            currentItemIndex++;

            bankRows.add([
              _fmtDate(e['date']),
              '$rowCounter',
              e['description']?.toString() ?? '',
              (e['source']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
                  ? '-'
                  : e['source'].toString(),
              _currencyFormat.format(_toDouble(e['amount'])),
              e['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
              _toDouble(e['currency_exchange'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
              ...rowCats,
              _fmtMoney(amt),
              (currentItemIndex == totalItemsInBatch)
                  ? _fmtMoney(batchTotal)
                  : '-',
            ]);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    bankRows.add([
      'TOTAL',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      '-',
      ...List.filled(catHeaders.length, '-'),
      _fmtMoney(grandTotalBank),
      _fmtMoney(grandTotalBank),
    ]);
    _tableDataCache['t5'] = ReportTableData(
      rows: bankRows,
      boldRows: bankBoldRows,
      headers: catHeaders,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _pickDateRange() async {
    final range = await AppDateRangePicker.show(
      context,
      initialRange: (_startDate != null && _endDate != null)
          ? DateTimeRange(start: _startDate!, end: _endDate!)
          : null,
    );
    if (range != null) {
      setState(() {
        _startDate = range.start;
        _endDate = range.end;
        _filterMode = 'range';
      });
      _fetchReport();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _exportExcel() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final api = context.read<AuthProvider>().api;

      final effectiveStartDate = _filterMode == 'range' && _startDate != null
          ? DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(_startDate!)
          : null;
      final effectiveEndDate = _filterMode == 'range' && _endDate != null
          ? DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(_endDate!)
          : null;

      final bytes = await api.getAnnualReportExcel(
        year: _filterMode == 'range' ? null : _selectedYear,
        mode: _filterMode,
        startDate: effectiveStartDate,
        endDate: effectiveEndDate,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      final suffix = _filterMode == 'range'
          ? '${DateFormat('yyyyMMdd').format(_startDate!)}-${DateFormat('yyyyMMdd').format(_endDate!)}'
          : '$_selectedYear';
      await FileHelper.saveAndOpenFile(
        context: context,
        bytes: bytes,
        filename: 'Pemasukan-Biaya_$suffix.xlsx',
        subFolder: 'Reports/Annual/Excel',
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Error: $e'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _asListMap(dynamic data) {
    if (data is! List) return [];
    return data
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e))
        .toList();
  }

  double _toDouble(dynamic value) {
    if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
    return double.tryParse((value ?? '').toString().replaceAll(',', '')) ?? 0;
  }

  String _fmtMoney(dynamic value) {
    final v = _toDouble(value);
    return 'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(v)}';
  }

  String _fmtDate(dynamic value) {
    final text = (value ?? '').toString();
    if (text.isEmpty) return '';
    try {
      final dt = DateTime.tryParse(text);
      return dt == null ? text : DateFormat('dd-MMM-yy').format(dt);
    } catch (_) {
      return text;
    }
  }

  Set<String> _defaultVisibleTablesForSheet(String sheet) {
    switch (sheet) {
      case 'sheet2':
        return {'t7', 't8'};
      case 'sheet3':
        return {'t9', 't10'};
      case 'sheet1':
      default:
        return {'t1', 't2', 't3', 't3a', 't3b', 't3c', 't4', 't5', 't6'};
    }
  }

  void _applySheet(String sheet) {
    setState(() {
      _activeSheet = sheet;
      _visibleTables = _defaultVisibleTablesForSheet(sheet);
    });
  }

  void _toggleTableVisibility(String tableId) {
    setState(() {
      if (tableId == 'all') {
        final currentConfigs = switch (_activeSheet) {
          'sheet1' => ['t1', 't2', 't3', 't3a', 't4', 't5', 't6'],
          'sheet2' => ['t7', 't8'],
          'sheet3' => ['t9', 't10'],
          _ => ['t1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', 't6'],
        };
        bool allVisible = currentConfigs.every(
          (id) => _visibleTables.contains(id),
        );
        if (allVisible) {
          for (var id in currentConfigs) {
            _visibleTables.remove(id);
          }
        } else {
          for (var id in currentConfigs) {
            _visibleTables.add(id);
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (_visibleTables.contains(tableId)) {
          _visibleTables.remove(tableId);
        } else {
          _visibleTables.add(tableId);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  void _showUnavailableInputMessage(String label) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text('$label belum tersedia di frontend saat ini.'),
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.warning,
      ),
    );
  }

  List<List<String>> _buildTable7Rows() {
    final divData = _reportData?['dividend'] ?? {};
    final profitLossExp = (_reportData?['profit_loss_expenses'] as Map?) ?? {};

    final revenueDirect = _toDouble(divData['revenue_direct'] ?? 0);
    final revenueOtherDb = _toDouble(divData['revenue_other_db'] ?? 0);
    final otherIncomeSetting = _toDouble(divData['other_income_setting'] ?? 0);

    final List<List<String>> rows = [];
    _profitLossBoldRows.clear();

    // PENDAPATAN
    _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['PENDAPATAN', '']);
    rows.add(['   PENDAPATAN LANGSUNG', _fmtMoney(revenueDirect)]);
    rows.add(['   PENDAPATAN LAIN LAIN', _fmtMoney(revenueOtherDb)]);
    _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['TOTAL PENDAPATAN', _fmtMoney(revenueDirect + revenueOtherDb)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    // Helper to add grouped expenses
    void addExpenseGroup(String mg, String label) {
      _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
      rows.add([label, '']);
      final items = _asListMap(profitLossExp[mg]);
      double groupTotal = 0;
      for (var item in items) {
        final name = item['name']?.toString() ?? '-';
        final amount = _toDouble(item['amount']);
        rows.add(['   $name', _fmtMoney(amount)]);
        groupTotal += amount;
      }
      _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
      rows.add(['TOTAL $label', _fmtMoney(groupTotal)]);
      rows.add(['', '']);
    }

    addExpenseGroup('BEBAN LANGSUNG', 'BEBAN LANGSUNG');
    addExpenseGroup('BEBAN TIDAK LANGSUNG', 'BEBAN TIDAK LANGSUNG');
    addExpenseGroup(
      'BIAYA ADMINISTRASI DAN UMUM',
      'BIAYA ADMINISTRASI DAN UMUM',
    );

    // TOTAL BIAYA
    final totalCost = _toDouble(divData['total_cost'] ?? 0);
    _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['TOTAL BIAYA', _fmtMoney(totalCost)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    // PENDAPATAN/BEBAN LAIN LAIN
    _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['PENDAPATAN/BEBAN LAIN LAIN', '']);
    rows.add(['   PENDAPATAN LAIN LAIN', _fmtMoney(otherIncomeSetting)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    // LABA RUGI SEBELUM PAJAK
    final profitBeforeTax = _toDouble(divData['profit_before_tax'] ?? 0);
    _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['LABA RUGI SEBELUM PAJAK', _fmtMoney(profitBeforeTax)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    // CORPORATE TAX
    final pph29Input = _toDouble(divData['tax_pph29_input'] ?? 0);
    _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['CORPORATE TAX (PPh 29)', _fmtMoney(pph29Input)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    // LABA / RUGI BERSIH
    final profitAfterTaxCash = _toDouble(divData['profit_after_tax_cash'] ?? 0);
    _profitLossBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['LABA / RUGI BERSIH', _fmtMoney(profitAfterTaxCash)]);

    return rows;
  }

  List<List<String>> _buildTable8Rows() {
    final divData = _reportData?['dividend'] ?? {};
    final settings = (divData['settings'] as Map?) ?? {};

    final openingCash = _toDouble(settings['opening_cash_balance'] ?? 0);
    final profitAfterTaxAccounting = _toDouble(
      divData['profit_after_tax_accounting'] ?? 0,
    );

    final ar = _toDouble(settings['accounts_receivable'] ?? 0);
    final pph23 = _toDouble(settings['prepaid_tax_pph23'] ?? 0);
    final prepaidExp = _toDouble(settings['prepaid_expenses'] ?? 0);
    final otherAr = _toDouble(settings['other_receivables'] ?? 0);

    // Total cash = opening + current accounting profit
    final totalCash = openingCash + profitAfterTaxAccounting;
    final lancar = totalCash + ar + pph23 + prepaidExp + otherAr;

    final inventory = _toDouble(settings['office_inventory'] ?? 0);
    final otherAssets = _toDouble(settings['other_assets'] ?? 0);
    final totalAktiva = lancar + inventory + otherAssets;

    final ap = _toDouble(settings['accounts_payable'] ?? 0);
    final salary = _toDouble(settings['salary_payable'] ?? 0);
    final shareholder = _toDouble(settings['shareholder_payable'] ?? 0);
    final accrued = _toDouble(settings['accrued_expenses'] ?? 0);
    final totalHutang = ap + salary + shareholder + accrued;

    final capital = _toDouble(settings['share_capital'] ?? 0);
    final retained = _toDouble(settings['retained_earnings_balance'] ?? 0);

    // Balancing Laba Tahun Berjalan (Plug Figure to match Excel logic)
    final labaTahunBerjalan = totalAktiva - totalHutang - capital - retained;
    final totalModal = capital + retained + labaTahunBerjalan;

    final List<List<String>> rows = [];
    _neracaBoldRows.clear();

    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['AKTIVA', '']);
    rows.add(['   AKTIVA LANCAR', '']);
    rows.add([
      '      KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN SEBELUMNYA',
      _fmtMoney(openingCash),
    ]);
    rows.add([
      '      KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN LAPORAN',
      _fmtMoney(profitAfterTaxAccounting),
    ]);
    rows.add(['      PIUTANG USAHA', _fmtMoney(ar)]);
    rows.add(['      PAJAK BAYAR DI MUKA (pph23)', _fmtMoney(pph23)]);
    rows.add(['      BIAYA BAYAR DI MUKA', _fmtMoney(prepaidExp)]);
    rows.add(['      PIUTANG LAIN LAIN', _fmtMoney(otherAr)]);
    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['   TOTAL AKTIVA LANCAR', _fmtMoney(lancar)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    rows.add(['   ACTIVA TETAP', '']);
    rows.add(['      INVENTARIS KANTOR', _fmtMoney(inventory)]);
    rows.add(['      AKTIVA LAIN LAIN', _fmtMoney(otherAssets)]);
    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['   TOTAL AKTIVA TETAP', _fmtMoney(inventory + otherAssets)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['TOTAL AKTIVA', _fmtMoney(totalAktiva)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['HUTANG DAN MODAL', '']);
    rows.add(['   HUTANG LANCAR', '']);
    rows.add(['      HUTANG USAHA', _fmtMoney(ap)]);
    rows.add(['      HUTANG GAJI', _fmtMoney(salary)]);
    rows.add(['      HUTANG PEMEGANG SAHAM', _fmtMoney(shareholder)]);
    rows.add(['      BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DIBAYAR', _fmtMoney(accrued)]);
    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['   TOTAL HUTANG LANCAR', _fmtMoney(totalHutang)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    rows.add(['   MODAL', '']);
    rows.add(['      MODAL SAHAM', _fmtMoney(capital)]);
    rows.add(['      LABA DI TAHAN', _fmtMoney(retained)]);
    rows.add(['      LABA TAHUN BERJALAN', _fmtMoney(labaTahunBerjalan)]);
    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['      TOTAL LABA (RUGI) DITAHAN', _fmtMoney(totalModal)]);
    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['   TOTAL MODAL', _fmtMoney(totalModal)]);
    rows.add(['', '']);

    _neracaBoldRows.add(rows.length);
    rows.add(['TOTAL HUTANG DAN MODAL', _fmtMoney(totalHutang + totalModal)]);

    return rows;
  }

  List<List<String>> _buildTable9Rows() {
    final divData = _reportData?['dividend'] ?? {};

    final revenueTotal = _toDouble(divData['revenue_total'] ?? 0);
    final pph23Client = _toDouble(divData['pph23_total'] ?? 0);
    final revenueReceived = revenueTotal - pph23Client;

    final totalExpense = _toDouble(divData['total_cost'] ?? 0);
    final profitBeforeTax = _toDouble(divData['profit_before_tax'] ?? 0);

    final pphBadanAuto = _toDouble(divData['tax_corporate_auto'] ?? 0);
    final taxShortfall = _toDouble(divData['tax_shortfall'] ?? 0);

    final profitAfterTaxAccounting = _toDouble(
      divData['profit_after_tax_accounting'] ?? 0,
    );
    final dividendDistributed = _toDouble(divData['total_amount'] ?? 0);
    final retainedProfit = profitAfterTaxAccounting - dividendDistributed;

    return [
      ['1', 'Revenue', _fmtMoney(revenueTotal)],
      ['2', 'Revenue Diterima (Setelah Pajak)', _fmtMoney(revenueReceived)],
      ['3', 'Biaya', _fmtMoney(totalExpense)],
      ['4', 'Profit SebelumTax', _fmtMoney(profitBeforeTax)],
      ['5', 'PPh Badan (22%*50%)', _fmtMoney(pphBadanAuto)],
      ['6', 'PPh 23 Dipotong oleh client', _fmtMoney(pph23Client)],
      ['7', 'Kekurangan Bayar PPh Badan', _fmtMoney(taxShortfall)],
      ['8', 'Profit After Tax', _fmtMoney(profitAfterTaxAccounting)],
      ['9', 'Deviden Dibagi', _fmtMoney(dividendDistributed)],
      ['10', 'Profit Ditahan', _fmtMoney(retainedProfit)],
    ];
  }

  List<List<String>> _buildTable11Rows() {
    if (_reportData == null) return [];
    final allAdminFees = _asListMap(_reportData!['admin_fees']?['data']);
    final adminFees =
        allAdminFees.where((e) => e['is_admin_fee_extra'] == true).toList();
    if (adminFees.isEmpty) return [];

    final rows = <List<String>>[];
    double total = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < adminFees.length; i++) {
      final item = adminFees[i];
      final amt = _toDouble(item['amount']);
      total += amt;

      rows.add([
        _fmtDate(item['date']),
        '${i + 1}',
        item['description']?.toString() ?? '',
        item['bank_name']?.toString() ?? '-',
        '0', // Jumlah
        item['currency']?.toString() ?? 'IDR',
        _toDouble(item['exchange_rate'] ?? 1).toStringAsFixed(0),
        _fmtMoney(amt).replaceFirst('Rp ', ''), // ADMINISTRASI
        item['settlement_type']?.toString().toUpperCase() ?? 'SINGLE',
      ]);
    }

    rows.add([
      'Total',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      '',
      _fmtMoney(total).replaceFirst('Rp ', ''),
      '',
    ]);

    return rows;
  }

  List<List<String>> _buildTable3aRows() {
    final adminFeesRoot = _reportData?['admin_fees'] ?? {};
    final allAdminFeesData = _asListMap(adminFeesRoot['data']);
    final adminFeesData =
        allAdminFeesData.where((e) => e['is_admin_fee_extra'] != true).toList();
    double totalAdmin = 0;

    final rows = adminFeesData.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
      final row = entry.value;
      final adminVal = _toDouble(row['idr_amount'] ?? row['amount']);
      final mainVal = _toDouble(row['main_amount']);
      totalAdmin += adminVal;
      return [
        _fmtDate(row['date']),
        '${entry.key + 1}',
        (row['description'] ?? '-').toString(),
        (row['bank_name'] ?? '-').toString(),
        _fmtMoney(mainVal).replaceFirst('Rp ', ''),
        (row['currency'] ?? 'IDR').toString(),
        _currencyFormat.format(_toDouble(row['exchange_rate'] ?? 1)),
        _fmtMoney(adminVal).replaceFirst('Rp ', ''),
        (row['settlement_type'] ?? 'single').toString().toUpperCase(),
      ];
    }).toList();

    if (rows.isNotEmpty) {
      rows.add([
        'Total',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        _fmtMoney(totalAdmin).replaceFirst('Rp ', ''),
        '',
      ]);
    }

    return rows;
  }

  List<List<String>> _buildTable3Rows() {
    final bankStatusRoot = _reportData?['bank_status'];
    final bankData = _asListMap(
      bankStatusRoot?['data'] ??
          _reportData?['bank_transactions']?['data'] ??

    return bankData.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
      final row = entry.value;

        _fmtDate(row['date'] ?? row['transaction_date']),
        '${entry.key + 1}',
        (row['bank_name'] ?? row['account_name'] ?? row['source'] ?? '-')
            .toString(),
        (row['transaction_type'] ?? row['type'] ?? '-').toString(),
        (row['description'] ?? row['remark'] ?? '-').toString(),
        _fmtMoney(row['amount'] ?? row['nominal'] ?? 0),
        _fmtMoney(row['balance'] ?? row['ending_balance'] ?? 0),
      ];
    }).toList();
  }

  List<List<String>> _buildTable6Rows() {
    final assetData = _asListMap(_reportData?['assets']?['data']);
    return assetData.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
      final row = entry.value;
      return [
        _fmtDate(row['purchase_date']),
        '${entry.key + 1}',
        (row['name'] ?? '-').toString(),
        _fmtMoney(row['purchase_price'] ?? 0),
        '${row['useful_life_months'] ?? 0} bln',
        _fmtMoney(row['monthly_depreciation'] ?? 0),
        _fmtMoney(row['accumulated_depreciation'] ?? 0),
        _fmtMoney(row['book_value'] ?? 0),
      ];
    }).toList();
  }

  void _handleInputMenuSelection(String id) {
    switch (id) {
      case 'input_income':
        _navTo(
          RevenueManagementScreen(
            initialYear: _selectedYear,
            initialFilterMode: _filterMode,
            initialStartDate: _startDate,
            initialEndDate: _endDate,
          ),
        );
        break;
      case 'input_tax':
        _navTo(
          TaxManagementScreen(
            initialYear: _selectedYear,
            initialFilterMode: _filterMode,
            initialStartDate: _startDate,
            initialEndDate: _endDate,
          ),
        );
        break;
      case 'input_bank':
        _navTo(BankManagementScreen(initialYear: _selectedYear));
        break;
      case 'input_asset':
        _navTo(const AssetManagementScreen());
        break;
      case 'input_balance':
        _navTo(
          BalanceSheetSettingsScreen(
            initialYear: _selectedYear,
            initialFilterMode: _filterMode,
          ),
        );
        break;
      case 'input_dividend':
        _navTo(
          DividendManagementScreen(
            initialYear: _selectedYear,
            initialFilterMode: _filterMode,
          ),
        );
        break;
      default:
        _showUnavailableInputMessage('Menu ini');
    }
  }

  void _navToDetail(String type, String id) {
    final intId = int.tryParse(id);
    if (intId == null) return;

    if (type.toLowerCase().contains('settlement')) {
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => SettlementDetailScreen(settlementId: intId),
        ),
      );
    } else if (type.toLowerCase().contains('advance') ||
        type.toLowerCase().contains('kasbon')) {
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => AdvanceDetailScreen(advanceId: intId),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  DateTime _parseDate(dynamic value) {
    final text = (value ?? '').toString();
    if (text.isEmpty) return DateTime(_selectedYear, 1, 1);
    return DateTime.tryParse(text) ?? DateTime(_selectedYear, 1, 1);
  }

  int? _extractImportedRow(dynamic text) {
    final raw = (text ?? '').toString();
    if (raw.isEmpty) return null;
    final m = RegExp(
      r'Imported from row\s+(\d+)',
      caseSensitive: false,
    ).firstMatch(raw);
    return m == null ? null : int.tryParse(m.group(1) ?? '');
  }

  int _extractBatchNumber(String text) {
    final match = RegExp(
      r'\bbatch\s*#?\s*(\d+)\b',
      caseSensitive: false,
    ).firstMatch(text);
    return match == null
        ? (1 << 30)
        : (int.tryParse(match.group(1) ?? '') ?? (1 << 30));
  }

  bool _isBatchSettlement(Map<String, dynamic> item) {
    final stype =
        (item['settlement_type'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();
    if (stype == 'batch') return true;
    if (stype == 'single') return false;
    final title = (item['settlement_title'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    return title.contains('batch');
  }

  String _extractNoteSubcategory(Map<String, dynamic> item) {
    final notes = (item['notes'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (notes.isEmpty) return '';
    final match = RegExp(
      r'\bSubcategory:\s*([^|]+)',
      caseSensitive: false,
    ).firstMatch(notes);
    return match?.group(1)?.trim() ?? '';
  }

  int _subcategorySortBucket(String label) {
    final text = label.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || text == '-') return 2;
    if (text.contains(',')) return 0;
    return 1;
  }

  List<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _groupAnnualExpenses(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> expenses,
  ) {
    final grouped = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
    for (final e in expenses) {
      final sid = (e['settlement_id'] ?? '').toString();
      final key = sid.isNotEmpty
          ? 'id:$sid'
          : 'title:${(e['settlement_title'] ?? '').toString()}';
      grouped.putIfAbsent(key, () => <Map<String, dynamic>>[]).add(e);
    }
    final groups = grouped.values.toList();
    for (final g in groups) {
      g.sort((a, b) {
        final bucketCmp = _subcategorySortBucket(
          _expenseSubcategoryLabel(a),
        ).compareTo(_subcategorySortBucket(_expenseSubcategoryLabel(b)));
        if (bucketCmp != 0) return bucketCmp;
        final aSub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(a).toLowerCase();
        final bSub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(b).toLowerCase();
        if (aSub != bSub) return aSub.compareTo(bSub);
        final aImported = _extractImportedRow(a['notes']);
        final bImported = _extractImportedRow(b['notes']);
        if (aImported != null || bImported != null) {
          final ai = aImported ?? (1 << 30);
          final bi = bImported ?? (1 << 30);
          if (ai != bi) return ai.compareTo(bi);
        }
        final da = _parseDate(a['date']);
        final db = _parseDate(b['date']);
        if (da != db) return da.compareTo(db);
        return (int.tryParse((a['id'] ?? '0').toString()) ?? 0).compareTo(
          int.tryParse((b['id'] ?? '0').toString()) ?? 0,
        );
      });
    }
    groups.sort((a, b) {
      final af = a.first;
      final bf = b.first;
      final aSub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(af);
      final bSub = _expenseSubcategoryLabel(bf);
      final subBucketCmp = _subcategorySortBucket(
        aSub,
      ).compareTo(_subcategorySortBucket(bSub));
      if (subBucketCmp != 0) return subBucketCmp;
      if (aSub.toLowerCase() != bSub.toLowerCase()) {
        return aSub.toLowerCase().compareTo(bSub.toLowerCase());
      }
      final aBatch = _isBatchSettlement(af);
      final bBatch = _isBatchSettlement(bf);
      if (aBatch != bBatch) return aBatch ? 1 : -1;
      final aDate = a
          .map((x) => _parseDate(x['date']))
          .reduce((x, y) => x.isBefore(y) ? x : y);
      final bDate = b
          .map((x) => _parseDate(x['date']))
          .reduce((x, y) => x.isBefore(y) ? x : y);
      if (aBatch && bBatch) {
        final aNum = _extractBatchNumber(
          (af['settlement_title'] ?? '').toString(),
        );
        final bNum = _extractBatchNumber(
          (bf['settlement_title'] ?? '').toString(),
        );
        if (aNum != bNum) return aNum.compareTo(bNum);
      }
      final dateCmpVal = aDate.compareTo(bDate);
      return dateCmpVal != 0
          ? dateCmpVal
          : (int.tryParse((af['settlement_id'] ?? '0').toString()) ?? 0)
              .compareTo(
              int.tryParse((bf['settlement_id'] ?? '0').toString()) ?? 0,
            );
    });
    return groups;
  }

  String _expenseSubcategoryLabel(Map<String, dynamic> item) {
    final backendSub = (item['subcategory_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (backendSub.isNotEmpty && backendSub != '-') return backendSub;
    final rawDesc = (item['description'] ?? '').toString();
    final extracted = RegExp(r'^\[(.*?)\]\s*(.*)$').firstMatch(rawDesc);
    if (extracted?.group(1) != null) return extracted!.group(1)!.trim();
    final noteSub = _extractNoteSubcategory(item);
    if (noteSub.isNotEmpty) return noteSub;
    return backendSub;
  }

  List<double> _getColumnWidths(String title, int colCount, bool useCompact) {
    List<double> widths;
    if (title.contains('Tabel 10')) {
      widths = [50, 250, 50, 180];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 9')) {
      widths = [50, 300, 180];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 1')) {
      widths = [
        100,
        50,
        400, // Activity
        160, // Invoice Value
        80,
        80,
        130,
        250, // Client
        120,
        150,
        120,
        120,
        100,
        180,
      ];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 2')) {
      widths = [
        100,
        50,
        400, // Activity
        150,
        80,
        80,
        140,
        120,
        140,
        120,
        140,
        120,
        140,
        120,
      ];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 3:')) {
      widths = [110, 50, 180, 150, 350, 160, 160];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 3A') || title.contains('Tabel 3B')) {
      widths = [100, 50, 350, 150, 150, 60, 80, 160, 110];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 4') || title.contains('Tabel 5')) {
      widths = [
        100,
        50,
        400,
        100,
        160,
        80,
        80,
        ...List<double>.filled(math.max(colCount - 9, 0), 200),
        150,
        150,
      ];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 6')) {
      widths = [100, 50, 400, 160, 100, 140, 140, 140];
    } else if (title.contains('Tabel 7') || title.contains('Tabel 8')) {
      final sw = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
      widths = [sw > 800 ? 350.0 : 250.0, 200.0];
    } else {
      widths = List<double>.filled(colCount, 150);
    }
    return widths.map((w) => w * _zoomLevel).toList();
  }

  Widget _buildTableCard({
    required String title,
    required List<String> headers,
    required List<List<String>> rows,
    required ScrollController controller,
    required ScrollController verticalController,
    Set<int> boldRows = const {},
    bool useCompact = false,
  }) {
    final colWidths = _getColumnWidths(title, headers.length, useCompact);
    final totalWidth = colWidths.fold<double>(0, (sum, w) => sum + w);
    const double leftScrollbarSpace = 14;

    return Card(
      color: _cardColor(context),
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        side: BorderSide(color: _dividerColor(context)),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: useCompact ? 6 : 10,
          vertical: useCompact ? 8 : 12,
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              title,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: _titleColor(context),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: useCompact ? 14 : 15,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            AppScrollbar(
              controller: verticalController,
              thumbVisibility: true,
              interactive: true,
              scrollbarOrientation: ScrollbarOrientation.left,
              notificationPredicate: (notification) =>
                  notification.metrics.axis == Axis.vertical,
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: leftScrollbarSpace),
                child: AppScrollbar(
                  controller: controller,
                  thumbVisibility: true,
                  interactive: true,
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  notificationPredicate: (notification) =>
                      notification.metrics.axis == Axis.horizontal,
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    controller: controller,
                    scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                    physics: HardwareKeyboard.instance.isControlPressed
                        ? const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics()
                        : const ClampingScrollPhysics(),
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: totalWidth,
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          // Header Row
                          Container(
                            width: totalWidth,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: _surfaceColor(context),
                              border: Border(
                                bottom: BorderSide(
                                  color: _dividerColor(
                                    context,
                                  ).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                                  width: 1.0,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: IntrinsicHeight(
                              child: Row(
                                mainAxisSize: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch ==
                                        CrossAxisAlignment.stretch
                                    ? MainAxisSize.max
                                    : MainAxisSize
                                        .min, // Helper to keep structure
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                children: headers.asMap().entries.map((e) {
                                  return _buildExpenseTableCell(
                                    value: e.value,
                                    width: colWidths[e.key],
                                    useCompact: useCompact,
                                    isBold: true,
                                    index: e.key,
                                    textAlign: (e.key == 0 &&
                                            (title.contains('Tabel 9') ||
                                                title.contains('Tabel 10')))
                                        ? TextAlign.center
                                        : (e.key == 2 &&
                                                title.contains('Tabel 10'))
                                            ? TextAlign.center
                                            : (e.key == 1 &&
                                                    !title
                                                        .contains('Tabel 9') &&
                                                    !title.contains('Tabel 10'))
                                                ? TextAlign.center
                                                : (_isNumericLikeCell(
                                                    headers[e.key],
                                                    e.key,
                                                    e.value,
                                                  )
                                                    ? TextAlign.right
                                                    : TextAlign.left),
                                    fontSize: 13,
                                    isLast: e.key == headers.length - 1,
                                  );
                                }).toList(),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          // Body
                          Builder(
                            builder: (context) {
                              final stableRowHeight =
                                  title.contains('Tabel 4') ? 60.0 : 52.0;
                              final viewportHeight = math
                                  .min(
                                    rows.length * stableRowHeight,
                                    useCompact ? 650.0 : 800.0,
                                  )
                                  .toDouble()
                                  .clamp(100.0, 800.0);
                              return SizedBox(
                                height: viewportHeight,
                                child: RepaintBoundary(
                                  child:
                                      NotificationListener<ScrollNotification>(
                                    onNotification: (notification) {
                                      if (notification.metrics.axis ==
                                              Axis.vertical &&
                                          _scrollController.hasClients) {
                                        final m = notification.metrics;
                                        if (notification
                                                is ScrollUpdateNotification &&
                                            notification.scrollDelta != null) {
                                          final d = notification.scrollDelta!;
                                          if ((d > 0 &&
                                                  m.pixels >=
                                                      m.maxScrollExtent) ||
                                              (d < 0 && m.pixels <= 0)) {
                                            _scrollController.position.jumpTo(
                                              (_scrollController.offset + d)
                                                  .clamp(
                                                0,
                                                _scrollController
                                                    .position.maxScrollExtent,
                                              ),
                                            );
                                          }
                                        }
                                      }
                                      return true;
                                    },
                                    child: ListView.builder(
                                      controller: verticalController,
                                      itemCount: rows.length,
                                      cacheExtent: 1000,
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                                      physics: const ClampingScrollPhysics(),
                                      itemBuilder: (context, rowIndex) {
                                        final row = rows[rowIndex];
                                        final isBold =
                                            boldRows.contains(rowIndex);
                                        return InkWell(
                                          onTap: title.contains('Tabel 3C')
                                              ? () =>
                                                  _navToDetail(row[3], row[8])
                                              : null,
                                          child: Container(
                                            width: totalWidth,
                                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                              color: isBold
                                                  ? _surfaceColor(context)
                                                  : (rowIndex.isEven
                                                      ? (_isDark(context)
                                                          ? const Color(
                                                              0xFF1E293B)
                                                          : const Color(
                                                              0xFFF1F5F9))
                                                      : (_isDark(context)
                                                          ? const Color(
                                                              0xFF0F172A)
                                                          : Colors.white)),
                                            ),
                                            child: IntrinsicHeight(
                                              child: Row(
                                                crossAxisAlignment:
                                                    CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                                children:
                                                    row.asMap().entries.map(
                                                  (e) {
                                                    return _buildExpenseTableCell(
                                                      value: e.value,
                                                      width: colWidths[e.key],
                                                      useCompact: useCompact,
                                                      isBold: isBold,
                                                      index: e.key,
                                                      textAlign: (e.key == 0 &&
                                                              (title.contains(
                                                                      'Tabel 9') ||
                                                                  title.contains(
                                                                      'Tabel 10')))
                                                          ? TextAlign.center
                                                          : (e.key == 2 &&
                                                                  title.contains(
                                                                      'Tabel 10'))
                                                              ? TextAlign.center
                                                              : (e.key == 1 &&
                                                                      !title.contains(
                                                                          'Tabel 9') &&
                                                                      !title.contains(
                                                                          'Tabel 10'))
                                                                  ? TextAlign
                                                                      .center
                                                                  : (_isNumericLikeCell(
                                                                          headers[e
                                                                              .key],
                                                                          e.key,
                                                                          e
                                                                              .value)
                                                                      ? TextAlign
                                                                          .right
                                                                      : TextAlign
                                                                          .left),
                                                      fontSize:
                                                          isBold ? 13 : 12,
                                                      isLast: e.key ==
                                                          row.length - 1,
                                                    );
                                                  },
                                                ).toList(),
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        );
                                      },
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  bool _isNumericLikeCell(String header, int index, [String? value]) {
    final text = header.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (text == '#') return true; // # column

    // Keywords for right-alignment
    final isNumericHeader = text.contains('amount') ||
        text.contains('amnt') ||
        text.contains('rate') ||
        text.contains('value') ||
        text.contains('val') ||
        text.contains('ppn') ||
        text.contains('pph') ||
        text.contains('dpp') ||
        text.contains('fee') ||
        text.contains('price') ||
        text.contains('life') ||
        text.contains('depr') ||
        text.contains('saldo') ||
        text.contains('mutasi') ||
        text.contains('nilai') ||
        text.contains('total') ||
        text.contains('base') ||
        text.contains('distributed') ||
        text.contains('retained') ||
        text.contains('person');

    if (isNumericHeader) return true;

    // Fallback: check if content looks like a formatted number
    // It should be mostly digits, dots, and commas, not long text.
    final cleanValue =
        (value ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'[Rp\s.]'), '').replaceAll(',', '.');
    if (cleanValue.isNotEmpty && double.tryParse(cleanValue) != null) {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  Widget _buildExpenseTableCell({
    required String value,
    required double width,
    required bool useCompact,
    required bool isBold,
    required TextAlign textAlign,
    required int index,
    double? fontSize,
    bool isLast = false,
  }) {
    return Container(
      width: width,
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: (useCompact ? 8.0 : 10.0) * _zoomLevel,
        vertical: (useCompact ? 8.0 : 10.0) * _zoomLevel,
      ),
      alignment: switch (textAlign) {
        TextAlign.right => Alignment.centerRight,
        TextAlign.center => Alignment.center,
        _ => Alignment.centerLeft,
      },
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(
          bottom: BorderSide(
            color: _dividerColor(context).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            width: 1.0,
          ),
          left: index == 0
              ? BorderSide(
                  color: _dividerColor(context).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                  width: 1.0,
                )
              : BorderSide.none,
          right: isLast
              ? BorderSide.none
              : BorderSide(
                  color: _dividerColor(context).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                  width: 1.0,
                ),
        ),
      ),
      child: Text(
        value,
        textAlign: textAlign,
        maxLines: 4,
        softWrap: true,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: (fontSize ?? 13) * _zoomLevel,
          fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
          color: isBold ? _titleColor(context) : _primaryText(context),
          height: 1.1,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCacheInfo(bool useCompact, {bool isCompact = false}) {
    final source = (_reportData?['cache_source'] ?? '').toString();
    final generated = (_reportData?['cache_generated_at'] ??
            _reportData?['generated_at'] ??
            '')
        .toString();
    String label = (source == 'cache')
        ? 'CACHE (tidak hit DB)'
        : (source == 'refresh' ? 'REFRESH (DB terbaru)' : 'INIT');
    return Container(
      width: isCompact ? null : double.infinity,
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: isCompact ? 12 : 16,
        vertical: isCompact ? 8 : 12,
      ),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _surfaceColor(context),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(context)),
      ),
      child: Text(
        isCompact
            ? '$label | Generated: ${generated.length > 10 ? generated.substring(11, 16) : ''}'
            : 'Display Source: $label | Generated: ${_fmtDate(generated)} ${generated.length > 10 ? generated.substring(11, 19).trim() : ''}',
        style: TextStyle(
          color: _bodyColor(context),
          fontSize: useCompact || isCompact ? 11 : 13,
          height: 1.2,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDisplayTables(bool useCompact) {
    if (_tableDataCache.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32.0),
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppTheme.primary),
        ),
      );
    }

    final t1 = _tableDataCache['t1']!;
    final t2 = _tableDataCache['t2']!;
    final t3 = _tableDataCache['t3']!;
    final t3a = _tableDataCache['t3a']!;
    final t3b = _tableDataCache['t3b']!;
