        if "OPERATION COST" in rs or "EXPENSES REPORT" in rs:
            dr = r
            break

    current_cid = 1
    current_sub_cids = []

    for r in range(41, dr if dr != -1 else 1000):
        total_amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 6)
        date_val = ws_v.cell(r, 2).value
        desc = str(ws_f.cell(r, 4).value or "").strip()
        source = str(ws_f.cell(r, 5).value or "").strip()

        # Detect Section Header
        if desc and not date_val and total_amt == 0:
            sh_ids = detect_subheader(desc)
            if sh_ids:
                current_cid = sh_ids[0]
                current_sub_cids = sh_ids

        if total_amt > 0 and date_val:
            found_any = False
            curr = str(ws_f.cell(r, 7).value or "IDR").strip().upper()
            rate = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 8, default=1.0)

            for col, cid in EXP_CAT_MAP.items():
                amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, col)
                if amt > 0:
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(desc[:200])}, 'Excel Row {r} Col {col}', 1, 'single', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(map_bank_source(source))}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                    )
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {amt}, {to_sql_val(date_val)}, {to_sql_val(source)}, {to_sql_val(curr)}, {rate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                    )
                    for sub_id in current_sub_cids:
                        data_ops.append(
                            f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                        )
                    data_ops.append("END $$;\n")
                    found_any = True

            if not found_any:
                cid = detect_cat(desc) or current_cid
                data_ops.append(
                    f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(desc[:200])}, 'Excel Row {r} Fallback', 1, 'single', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(map_bank_source(source))}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                )
                data_ops.append(
                    f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {total_amt}, {to_sql_val(date_val)}, {to_sql_val(source)}, {to_sql_val(curr)}, {rate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                )
                # Apply current subcategories even for fallback
                for sub_id in current_sub_cids:
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                    )
                data_ops.append("END $$;\n")

    if dr != -1:
        for r in range(dr, 1000):
            lbl = str(ws_f.cell(r, 2).value or "").upper()
            if "EXPENSE#" in lbl:
                ttl = str(ws_f.cell(r, 4).value or lbl)

                # Pre-scan for the first source in the batch to use as disbursement_source
                batch_source = "Cash"
                for sr in range(r + 1, r + 50):
                    s_val = ws_f.cell(sr, 5).value
                    if s_val:
                        batch_source = map_bank_source(s_val)
                        break
                    if (
                        "EXPENSE#" in str(ws_f.cell(sr, 2).value or "").upper()
                        or "TOTAL" in str(ws_f.cell(sr, 2).value or "").upper()
                    ):
                        break

                data_ops.append(
                    f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(ttl[:200])}, 'Excel Batch Row {r}', 1, 'batch', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(batch_source)}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                )
                for br in range(r + 1, 1000):
                    if (
                        "EXPENSE#" in str(ws_f.cell(br, 2).value or "").upper()
                        or "TOTAL" in str(ws_f.cell(br, 2).value or "").upper()
                    ):
                        break
                    bamt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, 6)
                    if bamt > 0 and ws_v.cell(br, 2).value:
                        bds = str(ws_f.cell(br, 4).value)

                        bfound = False
                        for col, cid in EXP_CAT_MAP.items():
                            sub_amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, col)
                            if sub_amt > 0:
                                data_ops.append(
                                    f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(bds)}, {sub_amt}, {to_sql_val(ws_v.cell(br, 2).value)}, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(br, 5).value)}, 'IDR', 1.0, 'approved', NOW());\n"
                                )
                                bfound = True

                        if not bfound:
                            bcid = detect_cat(bds)
                            data_ops.append(
                                f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {bcid}, {to_sql_val(bds)}, {bamt}, {to_sql_val(ws_v.cell(br, 2).value)}, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(br, 5).value)}, 'IDR', 1.0, 'approved', NOW());\n"
                            )
                data_ops.append("END $$;\n")

    # LABA RUGI
    ws2_f = next((wb_f[s] for s in wb_f.sheetnames if "Laba rugi" in s), None)
    ws2_v = next((wb_v[s] for s in wb_v.sheetnames if "Laba rugi" in s), None)
    if ws2_f:
        print("Extracting Laba Rugi...")
        items = {
            k: 0.0
            for k in [
                "PENDAPATAN LAINNYA",
                "CORPORATE TAX (PPh 29)",
                "KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN SEBELUMNYA",
                "KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN LAPORAN",
                "PIUTANG USAHA",
                "PAJAK BAYAR DI MUKA (pph23)",
                "BIAYA BAYAR DI MUKA",
                "PIUTANG LAIN LAIN",
                "INVENTARIS KANTOR",
                "HUTANG USAHA",
                "HUTANG GAJI",
                "HUTANG PEMEGANG SAHAM",
                "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR",
                "MODAL SAHAM",
                "LABA DI TAHAN",
            ]
        }
        MM = {
            "PENDAPATAN LAINNYA": "PENDAPATAN/BEBAN LAIN LAIN",
            "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR": "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DIBAYAR",
        }
        for r in range(1, 150):
            for c in range(1, 15):
                cv = str(ws2_f.cell(r, c).value or "").upper().strip()
                for k in items:
                    if MM.get(k, k).upper() in cv:
                        for off in range(15, 0, -1):
                            vl = to_num_cell(ws2_f, ws2_v, r, c + off)
                            if vl != 0:
                                items[k] = vl
                                break
        st = "INSERT INTO public.dividend_settings (year, profit_retained, opening_cash_balance, accounts_receivable, prepaid_tax_pph23, prepaid_expenses, other_receivables, office_inventory, other_assets, accounts_payable, salary_payable, shareholder_payable, accrued_expenses, share_capital, retained_earnings_balance, corporate_tax_pph29, other_income, created_at) VALUES ("
        st += f"2024, 0, {items['KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN SEBELUMNYA']}, {items['PIUTANG USAHA']}, {items['PAJAK BAYAR DI MUKA (pph23)']}, {items['BIAYA BAYAR DI MUKA']}, {items['PIUTANG LAIN LAIN']}, {items['INVENTARIS KANTOR']}, 0, {items['HUTANG USAHA']}, {items['HUTANG GAJI']}, {items['HUTANG PEMEGANG SAHAM']}, {items['BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR']}, {items['MODAL SAHAM']}, {items['LABA DI TAHAN']}, {items['CORPORATE TAX (PPh 29)']}, {items['PENDAPATAN LAINNYA']}, NOW());\n"
        data_ops.append(st)

    # DIVIDENDS
    ws3_f = next((wb_f[s] for s in wb_f.sheetnames if "Business Summary" in s), None)
    ws3_v = next((wb_v[s] for s in wb_v.sheetnames if "Business Summary" in s), None)
    if ws3_f:
        print("Extracting Dividends...")
        for r in range(1, 100):
            if "DEVIDEN" in str(ws3_f.cell(r, 2).value or "").upper():
                for dr in range(r + 1, r + 10):
                    n = ws3_f.cell(dr, 3).value
                    a = to_num_cell(ws3_f, ws3_v, dr, 5)
                    if n and a > 0:
                        data_ops.append(
                            f"INSERT INTO public.dividends (date, name, amount, recipient_count, tax_percentage, report_year, created_at) VALUES ('2024-12-31', {to_sql_val(n)}, {a}, 1, 10.0, 2024, NOW());\n"
                        )
                break

    data_ops.append("COMMIT;\n")

    # 3. Gabungkan DDL + Data Backup + Footer + Data Excel
    # Penting: data_ops diletakkan SETELAH footer_part agar sequence sudah di-set
    # oleh backup asli, sehingga INSERT baru mendapatkan ID yang benar (tidak bentrok).
    final_sql = header_ddl + data_part + footer_part + "".join(data_ops)

    # 4. Tambahkan perbaikan Sequence di paling akhir agar tidak bentrok ID-nya
    final_sql += "\n\n-- FIX SEQUENCES AFTER INSERTS --\n"
    for table in [
        "revenues",
        "taxes",
        "settlements",
        "expenses",
        "dividend_settings",
        "dividends",
    ]:
        final_sql += f"SELECT pg_catalog.setval('public.{table}_id_seq', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 1) FROM public.{table}), true);\n"

    with open(output_sql, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(final_sql)

    print(f"Selesai! SQL Full Hybrid tersimpan di: {output_sql}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    migrate()

import datetime as dt

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils.cell import column_index_from_string

# --- CONFIGURATION ---

backup_template_path = r"D:\Aplikasi\EWIApps\backend\scratch\scanner_fokus\data\backup_postgres_2026-05-06_17-27-35.sql"
output_sql = r"D:\Aplikasi\EWIApps\backend\scratch\scanner_fokus\hasilsql\migrasi_data_2024_hybrid_full.sql"

# --- CATEGORY MAPPING ---
FULL_MAPPING = {

CATEGORY_ID_MAP = {
    "TRANSPORTATION": 2,

}

SUBHEADER_MAPPING = {
    "hotel and loundry": [3, 7],
    "hotel and laundry": [3, 7],
    "hotel and logistic": [3, 27],
    "hotel": [3],
    "laundry": [7],

}

_CELL_REF_RE = re.compile(r"\$?([A-Z]{1,3})\$?(\d+)")


def to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, c, default=0.0, _depth=0):
    if _depth > 8:
        return default
    v_c = ws_v.cell(r, c).value
    if isinstance(v_c, (int, float)):
        return float(v_c)
    v_f = ws_f.cell(r, c).value
    if v_f is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(v_f, (int, float)):
        return float(v_f)
    t = str(v_f).strip()
    if t.startswith("="):
        w = t[1:].strip()
        w = re.sub(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%", lambda m: str(float(m.group(1)) / 100.0), w)

        def _rep(m):
            cl = m.group(1)
            ri = int(m.group(2))
            ci = column_index_from_string(cl)
            return str(to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, ri, ci, 0.0, _depth + 1))

        w = _CELL_REF_RE.sub(_rep, w).replace("^", "**")
        if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9\.\+\-\*/\(\)\s]+", w):
            try:
                return float(eval(w, {"__builtins__": {}}, {}))
            except:
                pass
    try:
        return float(str(t).replace(",", ""))
    except:
        return default


def to_sql_val(val):
    if (
        val is None
        or (isinstance(val, float) and np.isnan(val))
        or str(val).strip() == ""
    ):
        return "NULL"
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
        return str(val)
    if isinstance(val, dt.date):
        return f"'{val.isoformat()}'"
    if isinstance(val, dt.datetime):
        return f"'{val.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}'"
    s = str(val).replace("'", "''")
    return f"'{s}'"


def detect_cat(desc):
    d = str(desc).lower()
    for k, v in FULL_MAPPING.items():
        if k in d:
            return CATEGORY_ID_MAP.get(v.upper(), 1)
    for k, v in CATEGORY_ID_MAP.items():
        if k.lower() in d:
            return v
    return 1


def map_bank_source(raw_name):
    if not raw_name:
        return "Cash"
    n = str(raw_name).upper().strip()
    if "BCA" in n:
        return "BCA"
    if "BRI" in n:
        return "BRI"
    if "MANDIRI" in n:
        return "Mandiri"
    if "BNI" in n:
        return "BNI"
    if "CASH" in n:
        return "Cash"
    if "ADVANCE" in n:
        return "Advance"
    return "Lainnya"


def detect_subheader(text):
    if not text:
        return None
    t = text.lower().strip()
    for k, ids in SUBHEADER_MAPPING.items():
        if k in t:
            return ids
    return None


def migrate():
    print("Membangun Reconstructed SQL (Schema + Data 2024)...")

    # 1. Baca Schema dan Data dari Backup Asli
    with open(backup_template_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        backup_content = f.read()

    # Ekstrak daftar kategori dari backup untuk mapping dinamis
    print("Extracting categories from backup for dynamic mapping...")
    cat_id_by_name = {}
    try:
        cat_section = backup_content.split("COPY public.categories", 1)[1].split(
            "\\.", 1
        )[0]
        for line in cat_section.strip().split("\n"):
            parts = line.split("\t")
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                cid = int(parts[0])
                name = parts[1].strip().upper()
                cat_id_by_name[name] = cid
                # Tambahkan alias sederhana untuk pencocokan lebih baik (tanpa spasi/kurung)
                clean_name = re.sub(r"\(.*?\)", "", name).strip()
                cat_id_by_name[clean_name] = cid
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[!] Warning: Gagal mengekstrak kategori secara dinamis: {e}")

    # Header: Sampai COPY pertama
    header_ddl = backup_content.split("COPY public.", 1)[0]

    # Data: Dari COPY pertama sampai baris yang berisi '\.' terakhir
    last_dot_idx = backup_content.rfind("\n\\.\n")
    if last_dot_idx == -1:
        last_dot_idx = backup_content.rfind("\n\\.")

    if last_dot_idx != -1:
        data_part = backup_content[len(header_ddl) : last_dot_idx + 4]
        footer_part = backup_content[last_dot_idx + 4 :]
    else:
        data_part = ""
        footer_part = backup_content[len(header_ddl) :]

    # 2. Proses Excel Data
    wb_f = load_workbook(excel_path, data_only=False)
    wb_v = load_workbook(excel_path, data_only=True)
    ws_f = next((wb_f[s] for s in wb_f.sheetnames if "Revenue-Cost" in s), None)
    ws_v = next((wb_v[s] for s in wb_v.sheetnames if "Revenue-Cost" in s), None)

    # DETEKSI KOLOM KATEGORI SECARA DINAMIS (Row 40, mulai Col 9)
    print("Detecting category columns dynamically from Excel...")
    EXP_CAT_MAP = {}
    for col in range(9, 100):  # Scan hingga 100 kolom
        h = ws_v.cell(40, col).value
        if h is None:
            # Jika kosong, cek kolom selanjutnya, jika masih kosong berhenti
            if ws_v.cell(40, col + 1).value is None:
                break
            continue

        h_str = str(h).strip()
        h_upper = h_str.upper()
        # Bersihkan nama kategori (hapus info dalam kurung untuk pencocokan)
        clean_h = re.sub(r"\(.*?\)", "", h_upper).strip()

        # Cari di cat_id_by_name dengan normalisasi lebih kuat
        cid = None

        # Normalisasi: hapus spasi, hapus kurung, hapus karakter non-alfanumerik, ubah ke UPPER
        def super_clean(s):
            s = re.sub(r"\(.*?\)", "", str(s)).upper()
            return re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", s)

        target = super_clean(h_str)

        # 1. Coba match langsung
        for cat_name, cat_id in cat_id_by_name.items():
            if super_clean(cat_name) == target:
                cid = cat_id
                break

        # 2. Coba match parsial jika belum ketemu
        if not cid:
            for cat_name, cat_id in cat_id_by_name.items():
                sc_name = super_clean(cat_name)
                if sc_name and (sc_name in target or target in sc_name):
                    cid = cat_id
                    break

        # 3. Hardcoded fixes untuk typo umum di Excel
        if not cid:
            TYPO_MAP = {
                "INTEPRETASI": 20,  # Sering typo di excel Intepretasi vs Interpretasi
                "RESEARCH": 16,
                "OPERASI": 1,
                "ALAT": 18,
                "BARANG": 26,
                "RUANGAN": 31,
                "KANTOR": 30,
            }
            for typo, tid in TYPO_MAP.items():
                if typo in target:
                    cid = tid
                    break
        if cid:
            print(f"  Col {col}: Found Category '{h_str}' -> ID {cid}")
            EXP_CAT_MAP[col] = cid
        else:
            print(
                f"  Col {col}: Skipping header '{h_str}' (No matching category in DB)"
            )

    # Siapkan perintah pembersihan dan injeksi data 2024
    data_ops = [
        "\n-- CLEANUP OLD 2024 DATA BEFORE INJECTING FROM EXCEL --\n",
        "BEGIN;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.revenues WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.taxes WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.expense_subcategories WHERE expense_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.expenses WHERE settlement_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.settlements WHERE report_year = 2024));\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.expenses WHERE settlement_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.settlements WHERE report_year = 2024);\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.settlements WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.dividend_settings WHERE year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.dividends WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "\n-- INJECT DATA 2024 FROM EXCEL --\n",
    ]

    # REVENUES
    print("Extracting 2024 Revenues...")
    for r in range(8, 22):
        d_v = ws_v.cell(r, 2).value
        desc = ws_f.cell(r, 4).value
        val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 6)
        if d_v and desc and val > 0:
            rt = (
                "pendapatan_lain_lain"
                if "bunga bank" in str(desc).lower()
                else "pendapatan_langsung"
            )
            stmt = "INSERT INTO public.revenues (invoice_date, description, invoice_value, currency, currency_exchange, invoice_number, client, receive_date, amount_received, ppn, pph_23, transfer_fee, remark, revenue_type, created_at, report_year) VALUES ("
            stmt += f"{to_sql_val(d_v)}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {val}, 'IDR', 1.0, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(r, 9).value)}, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(r, 10).value)}, {to_sql_val(ws_v.cell(r, 11).value)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 12)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 13)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 14)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 15)}, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(r, 16).value)}, '{rt}', NOW(), 2024);\n"
            data_ops.append(stmt)

    # TAXES
    print("Extracting 2024 Taxes...")
    for r in range(27, 37):
        d_v = ws_v.cell(r, 2).value
        desc = ws_f.cell(r, 4).value
        val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 6)
        if d_v and desc and val > 0:
            # Nominal pajak ada di kolom genap setelah header (10, 12, 14, 16)
            ppn_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 10)
            pph21_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 12)
            pph23_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 14)
            pph26_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 16)
            stmt = "INSERT INTO public.taxes (date, description, transaction_value, currency, currency_exchange, ppn, pph_21, pph_23, pph_26, created_at, report_year) VALUES ("
            stmt += f"{to_sql_val(d_v)}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {val}, 'IDR', 1.0, {ppn_val}, {pph21_val}, {pph23_val}, {pph26_val}, NOW(), 2024);\n"
            data_ops.append(stmt)

    # EXPENSES & SETTLEMENTS
    print("Extracting 2024 Expenses...")
    dr = -1
    for r in range(40, 1000):
        rs = " ".join([str(ws_f.cell(r, c).value or "") for c in range(1, 10)]).upper()
        if "OPERATION COST" in rs or "EXPENSES REPORT" in rs:
            dr = r
            break

    current_cid = 1
    current_sub_cids = []

    for r in range(41, dr if dr != -1 else 1000):
        total_amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 6)
        date_val = ws_v.cell(r, 2).value
        desc = str(ws_f.cell(r, 4).value or "").strip()
        source = str(ws_f.cell(r, 5).value or "").strip()

        # Detect Section Header
        if desc and not date_val and total_amt == 0:
            sh_ids = detect_subheader(desc)
            if sh_ids:
                current_cid = sh_ids[0]
                current_sub_cids = sh_ids

        if total_amt > 0 and date_val:
            found_any = False
            curr = str(ws_f.cell(r, 7).value or "IDR").strip().upper()
            rate = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 8, default=1.0)

            for col, cid in EXP_CAT_MAP.items():
                amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, col)
                if amt > 0:
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(desc[:200])}, 'Excel Row {r} Col {col}', 1, 'single', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(map_bank_source(source))}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                    )
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {amt}, {to_sql_val(date_val)}, {to_sql_val(source)}, {to_sql_val(curr)}, {rate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                    )
                    for sub_id in current_sub_cids:
                        data_ops.append(
                            f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                        )
                    data_ops.append("END $$;\n")
                    found_any = True

            if not found_any:
                cid = detect_cat(desc) or current_cid
                data_ops.append(
                    f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(desc[:200])}, 'Excel Row {r} Fallback', 1, 'single', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(map_bank_source(source))}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                )
                data_ops.append(
                    f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {total_amt}, {to_sql_val(date_val)}, {to_sql_val(source)}, {to_sql_val(curr)}, {rate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                )
                # Apply current subcategories even for fallback
                for sub_id in current_sub_cids:
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                    )
                data_ops.append("END $$;\n")

    if dr != -1:
        for r in range(dr, 1000):
            lbl = str(ws_f.cell(r, 2).value or "").upper()
            if "EXPENSE#" in lbl:
                ttl = str(ws_f.cell(r, 4).value or lbl)

                # Pre-scan for the first source in the batch to use as disbursement_source
                batch_source = "Cash"
                for sr in range(r + 1, r + 50):
                    s_val = ws_f.cell(sr, 5).value
                    if s_val:
                        batch_source = map_bank_source(s_val)
                        break
                    if "EXPENSE#" in str(ws_f.cell(sr, 2).value or "").upper() or "TOTAL" in str(ws_f.cell(sr, 2).value or "").upper():
                        break

                data_ops.append(
                    f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(ttl[:200])}, 'Excel Batch Row {r}', 1, 'batch', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(batch_source)}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                )

                current_batch_cid = 1
                current_batch_sub_cids = []

                for br in range(r + 1, 1000):
                    b_lbl = str(ws_f.cell(br, 2).value or "").upper()
                    if "EXPENSE#" in b_lbl or "TOTAL" in b_lbl:
                        break

                    bamt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, 6)
                    bdate = ws_v.cell(br, 2).value
                    bds = str(ws_f.cell(br, 4).value or "").strip()
                    bsource = str(ws_f.cell(br, 5).value or "").strip()

                    # Detect Section Header inside batch
                    if bds and not bdate and bamt == 0:
                        sh_ids = detect_subheader(bds)
                        if sh_ids:
                            current_batch_cid = sh_ids[0]
                            current_batch_sub_cids = sh_ids

                    if bamt > 0 and bdate:
                        bfound = False
                        bcurr = str(ws_f.cell(br, 7).value or "IDR").strip().upper()
                        brate = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, 8, default=1.0)

                        for col, cid in EXP_CAT_MAP.items():
                            sub_amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, col)
                            if sub_amt > 0:
                                data_ops.append(
                                    f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(bds)}, {sub_amt}, {to_sql_val(bdate)}, {to_sql_val(bsource)}, {to_sql_val(bcurr)}, {brate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                                )
                                for sub_id in current_batch_sub_cids:
                                    data_ops.append(f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n")
                                bfound = True

                        if not bfound:
                            bcid = detect_cat(bds) or current_batch_cid
                            data_ops.append(
                                f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {bcid}, {to_sql_val(bds)}, {bamt}, {to_sql_val(bdate)}, {to_sql_val(bsource)}, {to_sql_val(bcurr)}, {brate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                            )
                            for sub_id in current_batch_sub_cids:
                                data_ops.append(f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n")
                data_ops.append("END $$;\n")

    # LABA RUGI
    ws2_f = next((wb_f[s] for s in wb_f.sheetnames if "Laba rugi" in s), None)
    ws2_v = next((wb_v[s] for s in wb_v.sheetnames if "Laba rugi" in s), None)
    if ws2_f:
        print("Extracting Laba Rugi...")
        items = {
            k: 0.0
            for k in [
                "PENDAPATAN LAINNYA",
                "CORPORATE TAX (PPh 29)",
                "KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN SEBELUMNYA",
                "KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN LAPORAN",
                "PIUTANG USAHA",
                "PAJAK BAYAR DI MUKA (pph23)",
                "BIAYA BAYAR DI MUKA",
                "PIUTANG LAIN LAIN",
                "INVENTARIS KANTOR",
                "HUTANG USAHA",
                "HUTANG GAJI",
                "HUTANG PEMEGANG SAHAM",
                "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR",
                "MODAL SAHAM",
                "LABA DI TAHAN",
            ]
        }
        MM = {
            "PENDAPATAN LAINNYA": "PENDAPATAN/BEBAN LAIN LAIN",
            "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR": "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DIBAYAR",
        }
        for r in range(1, 150):
            for c in range(1, 15):
                cv = str(ws2_f.cell(r, c).value or "").upper().strip()
                for k in items:
                    if MM.get(k, k).upper() in cv:
                        for off in range(15, 0, -1):
                            vl = to_num_cell(ws2_f, ws2_v, r, c + off)
                            if vl != 0:
                                items[k] = vl
                                break
        st = "INSERT INTO public.dividend_settings (year, profit_retained, opening_cash_balance, accounts_receivable, prepaid_tax_pph23, prepaid_expenses, other_receivables, office_inventory, other_assets, accounts_payable, salary_payable, shareholder_payable, accrued_expenses, share_capital, retained_earnings_balance, corporate_tax_pph29, other_income, created_at) VALUES ("
        st += f"2024, 0, {items['KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN SEBELUMNYA']}, {items['PIUTANG USAHA']}, {items['PAJAK BAYAR DI MUKA (pph23)']}, {items['BIAYA BAYAR DI MUKA']}, {items['PIUTANG LAIN LAIN']}, {items['INVENTARIS KANTOR']}, 0, {items['HUTANG USAHA']}, {items['HUTANG GAJI']}, {items['HUTANG PEMEGANG SAHAM']}, {items['BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR']}, {items['MODAL SAHAM']}, {items['LABA DI TAHAN']}, {items['CORPORATE TAX (PPh 29)']}, {items['PENDAPATAN LAINNYA']}, NOW());\n"
        data_ops.append(st)

    # DIVIDENDS
    ws3_f = next((wb_f[s] for s in wb_f.sheetnames if "Business Summary" in s), None)
    ws3_v = next((wb_v[s] for s in wb_v.sheetnames if "Business Summary" in s), None)
    if ws3_f:
        print("Extracting Dividends...")
        for r in range(1, 100):
            if "DEVIDEN" in str(ws3_f.cell(r, 2).value or "").upper():
                for dr in range(r + 1, r + 10):
                    n = ws3_f.cell(dr, 3).value
                    a = to_num_cell(ws3_f, ws3_v, dr, 5)
                    if n and a > 0:
                        data_ops.append(
                            f"INSERT INTO public.dividends (date, name, amount, recipient_count, tax_percentage, report_year, created_at) VALUES ('2024-12-31', {to_sql_val(n)}, {a}, 1, 10.0, 2024, NOW());\n"
                        )
                break

    data_ops.append("COMMIT;\n")

    # 3. Gabungkan DDL + Data Backup + Footer + Data Excel
    # Penting: data_ops diletakkan SETELAH footer_part agar sequence sudah di-set
    # oleh backup asli, sehingga INSERT baru mendapatkan ID yang benar (tidak bentrok).
    final_sql = header_ddl + data_part + footer_part + "".join(data_ops)

    # 4. Tambahkan perbaikan Sequence di paling akhir agar tidak bentrok ID-nya
    final_sql += "\n\n-- FIX SEQUENCES AFTER INSERTS --\n"
    for table in [
        "revenues",
        "taxes",
        "settlements",
        "expenses",
        "dividend_settings",
        "dividends",
    ]:
        final_sql += f"SELECT pg_catalog.setval('public.{table}_id_seq', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 1) FROM public.{table}), true);\n"

    with open(output_sql, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(final_sql)

    print(f"Selesai! SQL Full Hybrid tersimpan di: {output_sql}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    migrate()

```

1.  **Cek Kolom Kategori Utama (Prioritas 1)**: Lihat dulu di kolom 9 ke atas (kolom A, B, C, dst). Jika di baris item tersebut ada angka "1" atau nilai uang, berarti itu adalah **Kategori Induk**-nya.

3.  **Kalkulasi Mata Uang**: Jika mata uangnya USD, kita harus mengambil angka nominal aslinya (misal 75) dan kursnya (misal 16.051), bukan hasil perkalian IDR-nya saja.

Saya telah memperbarui script `generate_hybrid_migration_v3.py` dengan logika yang jauh lebih akurat ini.

### Perubahan Utama:

*   **Logika "Category First"**: Script sekarang memindai kolom-kolom kategori (A, B, C...) terlebih dahulu untuk menentukan `category_id` utama.
*   **Inherit Subcategories**: Jika item berada di bawah header "Hotel and Loundry", script akan otomatis memasukkan item tersebut ke subkategori *Accommodation* dan *Laundry* di tabel relasi, namun tetap menjaga kategori induknya sesuai kolom yang ada angkanya.
*   **Fix USD Nominal**:
    *   Jika Kolom G = `USD`, script akan mengambil nominal dari Kolom F (misal: 75).
    *   Script kemudian mengambil Kurs dari Kolom H (misal: 16.051).
    *   Data yang masuk ke database akan menjadi: `amount=75`, `currency=USD`, `rate=16051`. Di aplikasi, ini akan otomatis dihitung menjadi Rp 1.203.825.
*   **Pembersihan Data**: Menghilangkan error `UnboundLocalError` dan merapikan variabel yang tidak terpakai.

### Mengapa ini penting?
Dengan cara ini, data 2024 Anda tidak akan lagi "gepeng" (semuanya dianggap IDR atau semuanya masuk kategori umum). Data akan memiliki struktur yang sama persis dengan cara Anda menginput data baru di aplikasi Flutter sekarang.

_CELL_REF_RE = re.compile(r"\$?([A-Z]{1,3})\$?(\d+)")


def to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, c, default=0.0, _depth=0):
    if _depth > 8:
        return default
    v_c = ws_v.cell(r, c).value
    if isinstance(v_c, (int, float)):
        return float(v_c)
    v_f = ws_f.cell(r, c).value
    if v_f is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(v_f, (int, float)):
        return float(v_f)
    t = str(v_f).strip()
    if t.startswith("="):
        w = t[1:].strip()
        w = re.sub(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%", lambda m: str(float(m.group(1)) / 100.0), w)

        def _rep(m):
            cl = m.group(1)
            ri = int(m.group(2))
            ci = column_index_from_string(cl)
            return str(to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, ri, ci, 0.0, _depth + 1))

        w = _CELL_REF_RE.sub(_rep, w).replace("^", "**")
        if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9\.\+\-\*/\(\)\s]+", w):
            try:
                return float(eval(w, {"__builtins__": {}}, {}))
            except:
                pass
    try:
        return float(str(t).replace(",", ""))
    except:
        return default


def to_sql_val(val):
    if (
        val is None
        or (isinstance(val, float) and np.isnan(val))
        or str(val).strip() == ""
    ):
        return "NULL"
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
        return str(val)
    if isinstance(val, dt.date):
        return f"'{val.isoformat()}'"
    if isinstance(val, dt.datetime):
        return f"'{val.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}'"
    s = str(val).replace("'", "''")
    return f"'{s}'"


def detect_cat(desc):
    d = str(desc).lower()
    for k, v in FULL_MAPPING.items():
        if k in d:
            return CATEGORY_ID_MAP.get(v.upper(), 1)
    for k, v in CATEGORY_ID_MAP.items():
        if k.lower() in d:
            return v
    return 1


def map_bank_source(raw_name):
    if not raw_name:
        return "Cash"
    n = str(raw_name).upper().strip()
    if "BCA" in n:
        return "BCA"
    if "BRI" in n:
        return "BRI"
    if "MANDIRI" in n:

    if "BNI" in n:

    if "CASH" in n:

    if "ADVANCE" in n:

        def super_clean(s):

            return re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", s)

        "ALTER TABLE public.advances ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS returned_amount double precision DEFAULT 0;\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.advances ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disbursement_evidence_path text;\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.advances ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disbursement_evidence_filename text;\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.advances ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS return_evidence_path text;\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.advances ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS return_evidence_filename text;\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.advances ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_disbursement_approved boolean DEFAULT false;\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.advances ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_return_approved boolean DEFAULT false;\n",
        "\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_multi_cat boolean DEFAULT false;\n",
        "ALTER TABLE public.deadline_settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_multi_cat boolean DEFAULT false;\n",
        "\n",
        "-- UPDATE ALEMBIC VERSION TO LATEST HEAD --\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.alembic_version;\n",
        "INSERT INTO public.alembic_version (version_num) VALUES ('f4b9c2d7e8a1');\n",
        "\n-- CLEANUP OLD 2024 DATA BEFORE INJECTING FROM EXCEL --\n",
        "BEGIN;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.revenues WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.taxes WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.expense_subcategories WHERE expense_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.expenses WHERE settlement_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.settlements WHERE report_year = 2024));\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.expenses WHERE settlement_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.settlements WHERE report_year = 2024);\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.settlements WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.dividend_settings WHERE year = 2024;\n",
        "DELETE FROM public.dividends WHERE report_year = 2024;\n",
        "\n-- INJECT DATA 2024 FROM EXCEL --\n",
    ]

    # REVENUES
    print("Extracting 2024 Revenues...")
    for r in range(8, 22):
        d_v = ws_v.cell(r, 2).value
        desc = ws_f.cell(r, 4).value
        val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 6)
        if d_v and desc and val > 0:
            rt = (
                "pendapatan_lain_lain"
                if "bunga bank" in str(desc).lower()
                else "pendapatan_langsung"
            )
            stmt = "INSERT INTO public.revenues (invoice_date, description, invoice_value, currency, currency_exchange, invoice_number, client, receive_date, amount_received, ppn, pph_23, transfer_fee, remark, revenue_type, created_at, report_year) VALUES ("
            stmt += f"{to_sql_val(d_v)}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {val}, 'IDR', 1.0, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(r, 9).value)}, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(r, 10).value)}, {to_sql_val(ws_v.cell(r, 11).value)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 12)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 13)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 14)}, {to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 15)}, {to_sql_val(ws_f.cell(r, 16).value)}, '{rt}', NOW(), 2024);\n"
            data_ops.append(stmt)

    # TAXES
    print("Extracting 2024 Taxes...")
    for r in range(27, 37):
        d_v = ws_v.cell(r, 2).value
        desc = ws_f.cell(r, 4).value
        val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 6)
        if d_v and desc and val > 0:
            # Nominal pajak ada di kolom genap setelah header (10, 12, 14, 16)
            ppn_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 10)
            pph21_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 12)
            pph23_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 14)
            pph26_val = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 16)
            stmt = "INSERT INTO public.taxes (date, description, transaction_value, currency, currency_exchange, ppn, pph_21, pph_23, pph_26, created_at, report_year) VALUES ("
            stmt += f"{to_sql_val(d_v)}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {val}, 'IDR', 1.0, {ppn_val}, {pph21_val}, {pph23_val}, {pph26_val}, NOW(), 2024);\n"
            data_ops.append(stmt)

    # EXPENSES & SETTLEMENTS
    print("Extracting 2024 Expenses...")
    dr = -1
    for r in range(40, 1000):
        rs = " ".join([str(ws_f.cell(r, c).value or "") for c in range(1, 10)]).upper()
        if "OPERATION COST" in rs or "EXPENSES REPORT" in rs:
            dr = r
            break

    current_cid = 1
    current_sub_cids = []

    for r in range(41, dr if dr != -1 else 1000):
        total_amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 6)
        date_val = ws_v.cell(r, 2).value
        desc = str(ws_f.cell(r, 4).value or "").strip()
        source = str(ws_f.cell(r, 5).value or "").strip()

        # Detect Section Header
        if desc and not date_val and total_amt == 0:
            sh_ids = detect_subheader(desc)
            if sh_ids:
                current_cid = sh_ids[0]
                current_sub_cids = sh_ids

        if total_amt > 0 and date_val:
            found_any = False
            curr = str(ws_f.cell(r, 7).value or "IDR").strip().upper()
            rate = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, 8, default=1.0)

            for col, cid in EXP_CAT_MAP.items():
                amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, r, col)
                if amt > 0:
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(desc[:200])}, 'Excel Row {r} Col {col}', 1, 'single', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(map_bank_source(source))}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                    )
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {amt}, {to_sql_val(date_val)}, {to_sql_val(source)}, {to_sql_val(curr)}, {rate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                    )
                    for sub_id in current_sub_cids:
                        data_ops.append(
                            f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                        )
                    data_ops.append("END $$;\n")
                    found_any = True

            if not found_any:
                cid = detect_cat(desc) or current_cid
                data_ops.append(
                    f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(desc[:200])}, 'Excel Row {r} Fallback', 1, 'single', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(map_bank_source(source))}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                )
                data_ops.append(
                    f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(desc)}, {total_amt}, {to_sql_val(date_val)}, {to_sql_val(source)}, {to_sql_val(curr)}, {rate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                )
                # Apply current subcategories even for fallback
                for sub_id in current_sub_cids:
                    data_ops.append(
                        f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                    )
                data_ops.append("END $$;\n")

    if dr != -1:
        for r in range(dr, 1000):
            lbl = str(ws_f.cell(r, 2).value or "").upper()
            if "EXPENSE#" in lbl:
                ttl = str(ws_f.cell(r, 4).value or lbl)

                # Pre-scan for the first source in the batch to use as disbursement_source
                batch_source = "Cash"
                for sr in range(r + 1, r + 50):
                    s_val = ws_f.cell(sr, 5).value
                    if s_val:
                        batch_source = map_bank_source(s_val)
                        break
                    if (
                        "EXPENSE#" in str(ws_f.cell(sr, 2).value or "").upper()
                        or "TOTAL" in str(ws_f.cell(sr, 2).value or "").upper()
                    ):
                        break

                data_ops.append(
                    f"DO $$\nDECLARE sid int; eid int;\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.settlements (title, description, user_id, settlement_type, status, report_year, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, disbursement_source) \n  VALUES ({to_sql_val(ttl[:200])}, 'Excel Batch Row {r}', 1, 'batch', 'approved', 2024, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), {to_sql_val(batch_source)}) RETURNING id INTO sid;\n"
                )

                current_batch_cid = 1
                current_batch_sub_cids = []

                for br in range(r + 1, 1000):
                    b_lbl = str(ws_f.cell(br, 2).value or "").upper()
                    if "EXPENSE#" in b_lbl or "TOTAL" in b_lbl:
                        break

                    bamt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, 6)
                    bdate = ws_v.cell(br, 2).value
                    bds = str(ws_f.cell(br, 4).value or "").strip()
                    bsource = str(ws_f.cell(br, 5).value or "").strip()

                    # Detect Section Header inside batch
                    if bds and not bdate and bamt == 0:
                        sh_ids = detect_subheader(bds)
                        if sh_ids:
                            current_batch_cid = sh_ids[0]
                            current_batch_sub_cids = sh_ids

                    if bamt > 0 and bdate:
                        bfound = False
                        bcurr = str(ws_f.cell(br, 7).value or "IDR").strip().upper()
                        brate = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, 8, default=1.0)

                        for col, cid in EXP_CAT_MAP.items():
                            sub_amt = to_num_cell(ws_f, ws_v, br, col)
                            if sub_amt > 0:
                                data_ops.append(
                                    f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {cid}, {to_sql_val(bds)}, {sub_amt}, {to_sql_val(bdate)}, {to_sql_val(bsource)}, {to_sql_val(bcurr)}, {brate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                                )
                                for sub_id in current_batch_sub_cids:
                                    data_ops.append(
                                        f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                                    )
                                bfound = True

                        if not bfound:
                            bcid = detect_cat(bds) or current_batch_cid
                            data_ops.append(
                                f"  INSERT INTO public.expenses (settlement_id, category_id, description, amount, date, source, currency, currency_exchange, status, created_at) \n  VALUES (sid, {bcid}, {to_sql_val(bds)}, {bamt}, {to_sql_val(bdate)}, {to_sql_val(bsource)}, {to_sql_val(bcurr)}, {brate}, 'approved', NOW()) RETURNING id INTO eid;\n"
                            )
                            for sub_id in current_batch_sub_cids:
                                data_ops.append(
                                    f"  INSERT INTO public.expense_subcategories (expense_id, category_id) VALUES (eid, {sub_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n"
                                )
                data_ops.append("END $$;\n")

    # LABA RUGI
    ws2_f = next((wb_f[s] for s in wb_f.sheetnames if "Laba rugi" in s), None)
    ws2_v = next((wb_v[s] for s in wb_v.sheetnames if "Laba rugi" in s), None)
    if ws2_f:
        print("Extracting Laba Rugi...")
        items = {
            k: 0.0
            for k in [
                "PENDAPATAN LAINNYA",
                "CORPORATE TAX (PPh 29)",
                "KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN SEBELUMNYA",
                "KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN LAPORAN",
                "PIUTANG USAHA",
                "PAJAK BAYAR DI MUKA (pph23)",
                "BIAYA BAYAR DI MUKA",
                "PIUTANG LAIN LAIN",
                "INVENTARIS KANTOR",
                "HUTANG USAHA",
                "HUTANG GAJI",
                "HUTANG PEMEGANG SAHAM",
                "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR",
                "MODAL SAHAM",
                "LABA DI TAHAN",
            ]
        }
        MM = {
            "PENDAPATAN LAINNYA": "PENDAPATAN/BEBAN LAIN LAIN",
            "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR": "BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DIBAYAR",
        }
        for r in range(1, 150):
            for c in range(1, 15):
                cv = str(ws2_f.cell(r, c).value or "").upper().strip()
                for k in items:
                    if MM.get(k, k).upper() in cv:
                        for off in range(15, 0, -1):
                            vl = to_num_cell(ws2_f, ws2_v, r, c + off)
                            if vl != 0:
                                items[k] = vl
                                break
        st = "INSERT INTO public.dividend_settings (year, profit_retained, opening_cash_balance, accounts_receivable, prepaid_tax_pph23, prepaid_expenses, other_receivables, office_inventory, other_assets, accounts_payable, salary_payable, shareholder_payable, accrued_expenses, share_capital, retained_earnings_balance, corporate_tax_pph29, other_income, created_at) VALUES ("
        st += f"2024, 0, {items['KAS DAN SETARA KAS TAHUN SEBELUMNYA']}, {items['PIUTANG USAHA']}, {items['PAJAK BAYAR DI MUKA (pph23)']}, {items['BIAYA BAYAR DI MUKA']}, {items['PIUTANG LAIN LAIN']}, {items['INVENTARIS KANTOR']}, 0, {items['HUTANG USAHA']}, {items['HUTANG GAJI']}, {items['HUTANG PEMEGANG SAHAM']}, {items['BIAYA YANG MASIH HARUS DI BAYAR']}, {items['MODAL SAHAM']}, {items['LABA DI TAHAN']}, {items['CORPORATE TAX (PPh 29)']}, {items['PENDAPATAN LAINNYA']}, NOW());\n"
        data_ops.append(st)

    # DIVIDENDS
    ws3_f = next((wb_f[s] for s in wb_f.sheetnames if "Business Summary" in s), None)
    ws3_v = next((wb_v[s] for s in wb_v.sheetnames if "Business Summary" in s), None)
    if ws3_f:
        print("Extracting Dividends...")
        for r in range(1, 100):
            if "DEVIDEN" in str(ws3_f.cell(r, 2).value or "").upper():
                for dr in range(r + 1, r + 10):
                    n = ws3_f.cell(dr, 3).value
                    a = to_num_cell(ws3_f, ws3_v, dr, 5)
                    if n and a > 0:
                        data_ops.append(
                            f"INSERT INTO public.dividends (date, name, amount, recipient_count, tax_percentage, report_year, created_at) VALUES ('2024-12-31', {to_sql_val(n)}, {a}, 1, 10.0, 2024, NOW());\n"
                        )
                break

    data_ops.append("COMMIT;\n")

    # 3. Gabungkan DDL + Data Backup + Footer + Data Excel
    # Penting: data_ops diletakkan SETELAH footer_part agar sequence sudah di-set
    # oleh backup asli, sehingga INSERT baru mendapatkan ID yang benar (tidak bentrok).
    final_sql = header_ddl + data_part + footer_part + "".join(data_ops)

    # 4. Tambahkan perbaikan Sequence di paling akhir agar tidak bentrok ID-nya
    final_sql += "\n\n-- FIX SEQUENCES AFTER INSERTS --\n"
    for table in [
        "revenues",
        "taxes",
        "settlements",
        "expenses",
        "dividend_settings",
        "dividends",
    ]:
        final_sql += f"SELECT pg_catalog.setval('public.{table}_id_seq', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 1) FROM public.{table}), true);\n"

    with open(output_sql, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(final_sql)

    print(f"Selesai! SQL Full Hybrid tersimpan di: {output_sql}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    migrate()

```
